Gain 3 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Flash Freeze Charge</color> when the Charged Scissor strike hits. If the enemy is <color=#98EFF0>Frozen</color>, it always triggers <color=#98EFF0>Shatter</color>.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while charging the skill, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
When taking DMG from enemies while the skill is charging, that instance of DMG is nullified, and charging instantly completes.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Dodge.name: Flash Freeze
Dodge.desc: When Ellen has <color=#FFFFFF>Flash Freeze Charges</color>, the <color=#FFFFFF>Flash Freeze</color> effect is activated. Once <color=#FFFFFF>Flash Freeze</color> activates, <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attacks</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attacks</color> expend <color=#FFFFFF>Flash Freeze Charges</color>, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>. Ellen can have up to a maximum of 6 <color=#FFFFFF>Flash Freeze Charges</color>.

Dodge.name: Dash Attack: Monstrous Wave
Dodge.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Launches a dashing slash attack at enemies in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.

Dodge.name: Dash Attack: Cold Snap
Dodge.desc:
While <color=#FFFFFF>Flash Freeze</color> is active, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during dodge to activate:
Launches a dashing slash attack at enemies in front, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Consumes 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Flash Freeze Charge</color>.

Dodge.name: Dodge Counter: Reef Rock
Dodge.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Rapidly move through enemies with open scissors for a cutting strike, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Special.name: Special Attack: Drift
Special.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Use a quick tail sweep attack in front, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

Special.name: EX Special Attack: Tail Swipe
Special.desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Perform a forceful tail whip attack that deals massive <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Gain 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Flash Freeze Charge</color> upon striking an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After executing the move, you can immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>.

Special.name: EX Special Attack: Sharknami
Special.desc:
With enough Energy and after executing <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Tail Swipe</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Perform a powerful series of slashes ahead that deal massive <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Gain 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Flash Freeze Charge</color> upon striking an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After executing the move, you can immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>.

Chain.name: Chain Attack: Avalanche
Chain.desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Crash down from above and unleash an ice storm, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Chain.name: Ultimate: Endless Winter
Chain.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Crash down from above and unleash an ice storm before a powerful scissor strike, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Assist.name: Quick Assist: Shark Sentinel
Assist.desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Speedily move through the enemy with open scissors for a cutting strike, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When the character on the field is launched, drag the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} and press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Enter the <color=#FFFFFF>Roaming</color> state, enabling dashing movement.
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Roaming</color> state, use the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} to change directions and release to stop.
Character is invulnerable briefly when triggering the skill.
Upon triggering a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, Ellen gains the <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Charge</color> effect, shortening the charging time of <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Arctic Ambush</color>, lasting up to 5s or until it triggers once.

Assist.name: Defensive Assist: Wavefront Impact
Assist.desc:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Assist.name: Assist Follow-Up: Shark Cruiser
Assist.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Charge and slash enemies in front, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Press repeatedly or hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during the attack to extend the skill duration.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer
Basic.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Launch up to five piercing attacks ahead, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> and <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
When the 5th hit of the Basic Attack hits an enemy, it generates 2 <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Quivers</color>.
After activating a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, the next time Harumasa activates the 5th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer</color> and hits an enemy with it, it generates 6 <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Quivers</color>.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer - Drift
Basic.desc:
During <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer</color>, drag the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} and press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Shoot a ranged piercing attack and reposition towards the corresponding drag direction, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Falling Feather
Basic.desc:
After the 5th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer</color>, a <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color>, an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, or a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Immediately shoot <color=#FFFFFF>Falling Feather</color> at enemies ahead, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to aim at a target and release <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
After drawing the bowstring and aiming, shoot <color=#FFFFFF>Falling Feather</color> at the target, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Ha-Oto no Ya
Basic.desc:
When the 5th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer</color>/<color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>/<color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> hits an enemy or the ground, it can generate 2/6/6 <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Quivers</color>. If there are no <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Quivers</color> on the field when any squad member applies an Attribute Anomaly to an enemy, generate 6 <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Quivers</color>. This effect can trigger once every 12s.
There can be up to 6 <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Quivers</color> present at a time. If there are any <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Quivers</color> present when Harumasa fires and hits enemies with <color=#FFFFFF>Falling Feather</color>, the <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Quivers</color> will activate and fire <color=#FFFFFF>Ha-Oto no Ya</color> at the enemies hit by <color=#FFFFFF>Falling Feather</color>, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
<color=#FFFFFF>Ha-Oto no Ya</color> will apply <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Prison</color> to enemies hit, stacking up to 8 times and lasting 10s, repeated triggers reset the duration. While a target has at least 2 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Prison</color>, they will be <color=#FFFFFF>X-Marked</color>.

Dodge.name: Dodge: Quick Flash
Dodge.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Dodge.name: Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru
Dodge.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Launch multiple piercing attacks ahead, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.

Dodge.name: Dodge Counter: Hidden Edge
Dodge.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Pierces enemies in front, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Dodge.name: Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash
Dodge.desc:
While there are <color=#FFFFFF>X-Marked</color> enemies on the field, Harumasa will enter the <color=#FFFFFF>Awakened</color> state, switching <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru</color> for <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash</color>.

While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Awakened</color> state, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Rush forwards to the closest <color=#FFFFFF>X-Marked</color> enemy and execute a powerful slash, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
When the slash hits the target, it consumes 2 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Prison</color>. With less than 2 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Prison</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>X-Marked</color> will be removed from the enemy. Before <color=#FFFFFF>X-Marked</color> is removed, repeatedly press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to repeatedly use <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash</color>. While no <color=#FFFFFF>X-Marked</color> enemies exist on the field, Harumasa leaves the <color=#FFFFFF>Awakened</color> state.
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Awakened</color> state, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Falling Feather</color> to quickly follow up with <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash</color>.
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.

Dodge.name: Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash
Dodge.desc:
While there are <color=#FFFFFF>X-Marked</color> enemies on the field, Harumasa will enter the <color=#FFFFFF>Awakened</color> state, switching <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru</color> for <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash</color>.

While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Awakened</color> state, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Rush forward to the closest <color=#FFFFFF>X-Marked</color> enemy and execute a powerful slash, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>. Hitting a Stunned enemy triggers Chasing Thunder, dealing 1 instance of additional <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
When the slash hits the target, it consumes 2 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Prison</color>. With less than 2 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Prison</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>X-Marked</color> will be removed from the enemy. Before <color=#FFFFFF>X-Marked</color> is removed, repeatedly press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to repeatedly use <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash</color>. While no <color=#FFFFFF>X-Marked</color> enemies exist on the field, Harumasa leaves the <color=#FFFFFF>Awakened</color> state.
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Awakened</color> state, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Falling Feather</color> to quickly follow up with <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash</color>.
Enemy attacks can be blocked during the 1st hit of the skill. The pursuit effect of the second and third hits is increased.
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.

Dodge.name: Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash

Special.name: Special Attack: Nowhere to Hide
Special.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Launch an arrow forward, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

Special.name: EX Special Attack: Nowhere to Run
Special.desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Launch daggers and an enhanced arrow ahead, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
When the enhanced arrow hits an enemy or the ground, it generates 6 <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Quivers</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Special.name: EX Special Attack: Nowhere to Run - Patrol
Special.desc:
With enough energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> after using the 4th/5th attack of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash</color>, an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter: Hidden Edge</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist: Braced Bow</color> to activate:
Fire enhanced arrows forward in rapid succession, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
When the first enhanced arrow hits an enemy or the ground, 6 <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Quivers</color> are generated. When the final enhanced arrow hits an enemy, it activates the <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Quivers</color> on the field, firing <color=#FFFFFF>Ha-Oto no Ya</color> at the target, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
When the target's <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Prison</color> stacks are close to the maximum, fewer <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Quivers</color> will be activated.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Special.name: EX Special Attack: Nowhere to Run
EX Special Attack: Nowhere to Run - Patrol

Chain.name: Chain Attack: Kai - Hanare
Chain.desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleash a piercing attack on enemies in a large area ahead then fire an enhanced arrow, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
When the arrow hits the ground, it generates 6 <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Quivers</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Chain.name: Ultimate: Zanshin
Chain.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Unleash a piercing attack on enemies in a large area ahead, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Chain.name: Zanshin - Scattered Blossoms
Chain.desc:
Activates ALT automatically after Ultimate: Zanshin:
Unleashes a wide-area piercing attack against enemies in front, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>. This is considered Ultimate DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Assist.name: Quick Assist: Braced Bow
Assist.desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Unleash a piercing attack at enemies ahead, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Assist.name: Defensive Assist: Yugamae
Assist.desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Assist.name: Assist Follow-Up: Yugamae - Slash
Assist.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Unleash a series of slashes at enemies ahead, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Whack the Dimwit
Basic.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Order Drusilla and Anastella to attack up to 4 times, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> and <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Performing other actions with Rina during Drusilla and Anastella's attacks will not interrupt Rina's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> combo count.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Shoo the Fool
Basic.desc:
Hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> or <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Calls back Drusilla and Anastella to swing them around for a ranged attack, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Morning Cleanup
Basic.desc: After Rina uses an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, she enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Spotless</color> state for 13s. During this time, Drusilla or Anastella attacks an enemy once every 2.5s, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> and <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>, and grants 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Fright</color>, up to a maximum of 6 stacks. After using the skill, Drusilla and Anastella's exit timer resets.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Midnight Cleanup
Basic.desc: When <color=#FFFFFF><Term:1000026></Term></color> reaches 6 stacks, the next <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Morning Cleanup</color> performed by Drusilla or Anastella consumes all <color=#FFFFFF>Fright</color> stacks and is replaced with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Midnight Cleanup</color>, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>. After using the skill, Drusilla and Anastella's exit timer resets.

Dodge.name: Dodge: Dress Adjustment
Dodge.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Dodge.name: Dash Attack: Sudden Surprise
Dodge.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Order Drusilla and Anastella to execute a piercing attack, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.

Dodge.name: Dodge Counter: Bangboo Callback
Dodge.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Order Drusilla and Anastella to spin forward and trigger an explosion, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Special.name: Special Attack: Beat the Blockhead
Special.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Order Anastella to execute a downward smash, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

Special.name: EX Special Attack: Dimwit Disappearing Trick
Special.desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Commands Drusilla and Anastella to unleash a continuous downward smash attack, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> is triggered.

Special.name: EX Special Attack: Dimwit Disappearing Trick

Chain.name: Chain Attack: Code of Conduct
Chain.desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Order Drusilla and Anastella to push forward and generate a ball-shaped electrical field that deals massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
During this skill, Drusilla and Anastella are unable to perform <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attacks</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attacks</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attacks</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attacks</color>, but can be recalled to Rina's side through <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Shoo the Fool</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
A <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.

Chain.name: Ultimate: The Queen's Attendants
Chain.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Commands Drusilla and Anastella to spin forward, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
During this skill, Drusilla and Anastella are unable to respond to <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> commands, but can be recalled to Rina's side through <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Shoo the Fool</color>.
Upon activating this skill, other squad members recover 10 Energy. The next character to switch in recovers an additional 20 Energy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> is triggered.

Assist.name: Quick Assist: Duple Meter Allemande
Assist.desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Order Drusilla and Anastella to spin forward and trigger an explosion, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Assist.name: Evasive Assist: Triple Meter Courante
Assist.desc:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Dodges the enemy's attack and activates <color=#FFFFFF>Vital View</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Assist.name: Assist Follow-Up: Quadruple Meter Gavotte
Assist.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after an <color=#FFFFFF>Evasive Assist</color> to activate:
Commands Drusilla and Anastella to continuously advance while generating a vortex of electricity, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
While using this skill, Rina can quickly chain into <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Dimwit Disappearing Trick</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Tsukuyomi Kagura
Basic.desc:
Yanagi has two stances: <color=#FFFFFF>Jougen</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Kagen</color>.
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Execute up to five forward slashes based on the current stance, causing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> and <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
During combat, Yanagi gains the corresponding stance buff based on her current stance:
<color=#FFFFFF>Jougen</color> stance buff: <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> increases by 10%. Anti-Interrupt Level increases during <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attacks</color>.
<color=#FFFFFF>Kagen</color> stance buff: PEN Ratio increases by 10%. Interrupt Level increases for <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attacks</color>.
For 8s after switching stances, Yanagi retains the bonus from the previous stance.

Dodge.name: Dodge: Wandering Breeze
Dodge.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Dodge.name: Dash Attack: Fleeting Flight
Dodge.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.

Dodge.name: Dodge Counter: Rapid Retaliation
Dodge.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, you can immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of the current stance's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>.

Special.name: Special Attack: Ruten
Special.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Perform a forward slash, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>, and switch the current stance.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.
If activated after the 3rd, 4th, or 5th hit of a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, it activates <color=#FFFFFF>Swift Ruten</color>, speeding up the slashes while switching her current stance.
Block enemy attacks while <color=#FFFFFF>Swift Ruten</color> is active.
Upon activating <color=#FFFFFF>Swift Ruten</color>, Yanagi can immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of the current stance's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>.

Special.name: EX Special Attack: Gekka Ruten
Special.desc:
With enough Energy, hold <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Charge up power for a quick forward thrust, followed by a downward attack, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Upon executing the thrust, Yanagi switches stances and enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Shinrabanshou</color> state, lasting 15s. For the duration of this state, when following up with a subsequent <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> from the 5th hit of a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> or other skills, the combo will begin directly from the 3rd hit of the <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>.
If the downward attack hits an enemy suffering an Anomaly, it triggers a special <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> effect, <color=#FFFFFF>Polarity Disorder</color>, dealing 15% of the original <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> effect's DMG to the target, plus an additional <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:5+AvatarSkillLevel(1)*2.25,100,2}%</color> of Yanagi's Anomaly Proficiency. <color=#FFFFFF>Polarity Disorder</color> will not remove the target's Anomaly.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Chain.name: Chain Attack: Celestial Harmony
Chain.desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Switch stances and unleash a powerful slash on enemies in front, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, you can immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of the current stance's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>.

Chain.name: Ultimate: Raiei Tenge
Chain.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Yanagi unleashes her potential and delivers a powerful slash to a large area of enemies in front in a very short time, followed by an additional lightning strike, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
When the lightning strike hits an enemy affected by an Attribute Anomaly, it triggers a special <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> effect called <color=#FFFFFF>Polarity Disorder</color>. This deals DMG equal to 15% of the original <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> effect plus an additional <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:5+AvatarSkillLevel(3)*2.25,100,2}%</color> of Yanagi's Anomaly Proficiency. <color=#FFFFFF>Polarity Disorder</color> will not remove the target's Anomaly.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, Yanagi can immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of the current stance's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>.

Assist.name: Quick Assist: Blade of Elegance
Assist.desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, you can immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of the current stance's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>.

Assist.name: Defensive Assist: Radiant Reversal
Assist.desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Assist.name: Assist Follow-Up: Weeping Willow Stab
Assist.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
