Special.name: EX Special Attack: Engine Spin
Special.desc:
With enough Energy, continue holding <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> after <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Tire Spin</color> reaches maximum charge level to activate:
Rapidly spins, unleashing powerful spinning slashes around her and dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
This skill consumes Energy continuously for up to 3s.
During the skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.

Special.name: EX Special Attack: Really Heavy
Special.desc:
During <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Engine Spin</color>, release <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Piper unleashes a downward smash attack, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
If the duration of <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Engine Spin</color> reaches its limit or Energy drops to 20, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Really Heavy</color> will automatically activate.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Chain.name: Chain Attack: Buckle Up
Chain.desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful downward smash at enemies ahead in a large area, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Chain.name: Ultimate: Hold~ On~ Tight~
Chain.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Rapidly spins, unleashing powerful spinning slashes at enemies in a large area ahead, followed by a downward smash, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Assist.name: Quick Assist: Brake Tap
Assist.desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Launches a downward smash attack at enemies in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Assist.name: Defensive Assist: Emergency Brake
Assist.desc:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Points</color> when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Assist.name: Assist Follow-Up: Overtaking Maneuver
Assist.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Charge and slash enemies in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Dark Abyss Quartet
Basic.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Perform up to four attacks forward, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> and <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
The fourth attack is a shot. During this attack, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to charge and perform a charged shot.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased during the fourth attack, and DMG received is reduced by 40%.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Dark Abyss Concerto
Basic.desc:
After the 4th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Dark Abyss Quartet</color>, the shot of <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter: Phantasm - Slash</color>, or the shot of <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist: Elegy</color>, press or hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Throw the scythe forward to perform a slash, followed by a shot, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
During the shot, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to charge and perform a charged shot.
During this skill, Anti-Interrupt level is increased, and DMG received is reduced by 40%.

Dodge.name: Dodge: Phantasm
Dodge.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Dodge.name: Dash Attack: Phantasm - Shatter
Dodge.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Launch a dashing attack at enemies in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.

Dodge.name: Dodge Counter: Phantasm - Slash
Dodge.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Performs a series of attacks on enemies in front, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
During the skill, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to launch a shot. During the shot, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to charge and perform a charged shot.
The shot is considered a Basic Attack, with its DMG treated as Basic Attack DMG.
After the skill is used, it can be directly followed up with the 4th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Dark Abyss Quartet</color>.
During the skill's ranged phase, Anti-Interrupt level is increased, and DMG received is reduced by 40%.
Invulnerable during the slashes and ranged retreat of the skill.

Special.name: Special Attack: Soul Hunter - Judgment
Special.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Spins the scythe and then unleashes a forward slash, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

Special.name: EX Special Attack: Soul Hunter - Punishment
Special.desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Spins the scythe to attack and then executes a powerful Finishing Move, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
This skill is not counted as a heavy attack.
After the skill is used, it can be directly followed up with the 4th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Dark Abyss Quartet</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Special.name: EX Special Attack: Soul Hunter - Punishment

Chain.name: Chain Attack: Trick of Fate
Chain.desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Dash forward to perform a slash across a large area, then launch a shot, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
The shot activated by this skill is considered a charged shot.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Chain.name: Ultimate: Blaspheme
Chain.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Throws the scythe in a powerful spinning attack, then launches a Finishing Move, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
This skill is not counted as a heavy attack.
After the skill is used, it can be directly followed up with the 4th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Dark Abyss Quartet</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Assist.name: Quick Assist: Elegy
Assist.desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Performs a series of attacks on enemies in front, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
During the skill, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to launch a shot. During the shot, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to charge and perform a charged shot.
The shot is considered a Basic Attack, with its DMG treated as Basic Attack DMG.
After the skill is used, it can be directly followed up with the 4th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Dark Abyss Quartet</color>.
During the skill's ranged phase, Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, and DMG received is reduced by 40%.
Invulnerable during the slashes and ranged retreat of the skill.

Assist.name: Defensive Assist: The End Has Not Come
Assist.desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Assist.name: Assist Follow-Up: Ace Reversal
Assist.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Dash forward and perform two slashes, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
After the skill is used, it can be directly followed up with the 4th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Dark Abyss Quartet</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Assist.name: Defensive Assist: The End Has Not Come

Basic.name: Basic Attack: High-Pressure Flamethrower
Basic.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Unleashes up to 5 attacks in front, followed by a powerful flame blade strike, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> and <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.

Dodge.name: Dodge: Flickering Flames
Dodge.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Dodge.name: Dash Attack: Rush Command
Dodge.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Perform a quick forward attack, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.

Dodge.name: Dodge Counter: Counter Strike Opportunity
Dodge.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Launch a series of attacks on enemies in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> and <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Special.name: Special Attack: Blazing Chamber
Special.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Thrust forward and perform a tail attack, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

Special.name: Special Attack: Corrosive Flash
Special.desc:
Automatically triggers during ally attacks:
Unleashes 4 laser Aftershock attacks, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Triggers once per 5s.
Upon activating this skill, restore 20 Bottled Heat.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Special.name: EX Special Attack: Watch Your Step
Special.desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Perform a sweeping laser attack forward, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
After using this skill, immediately follow up with the powerful fire blade from the Basic Attack.
Upon activating this skill, restore 20 Bottled Heat.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Special.name: EX Special Attack: Crimson Vortex
Special.desc:
When off-field with 60 or more Energy, automatically triggers during ally attacks:
Performs a sweeping laser attack in an area around, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Upon activating this skill, restore 20 Bottled Heat.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Special.name: EX Special Attack: Heat Charge
Special.desc:
When Bottled Heat is greater than or equal to 100, hold <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Consume 100 Bottled Heat to continuously fire a laser forward, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
When firing begins, triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>.
After continuous firing for a period, firepower increases, greatly boosting the skill's Interrupt Level.
When attacked during firing, will parry enemy attacks and immediately increase firepower.
When maximum firing duration is reached, automatically activates EX Special Attack: Fiery Eruption.
During the low firepower phase, Anti-Interrupt Level increases and DMG taken is reduced by 40%, while character is invulnerable during the high firepower phase.

Special.name: EX Special Attack: Fiery Eruption
Special.desc:
Automatically activates after EX Special Attack: Heat Charge reaches maximum firing time:
Performs a spinning attack forward, then fires a laser ahead dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Special.name: EX Special Attack: Watch Your Step

Chain.name: Chain Attack: Overheated Barrel
Chain.desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Perform a spinning attack forward, then fire a laser ahead, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Upon activating this skill, restore 20 points of Bottled Heat.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Chain.name: Ultimate: Dance With Fire
Chain.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Perform a spinning attack forward, then fire a laser ahead, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
When leaping into the air, a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> will be triggered. If the <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> is activated, Orphie & Magus will extend the laser firing duration.
Upon activating this skill, recover 20 Bottled Heat.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Assist.name: Quick Assist: Searing Slash
Assist.desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Unleash a series of attacks on enemies in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> and <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Assist.name: Defensive Assist: Blazing Gunblade
Assist.desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Assist.name: Assist Follow-Up: Boiling Pierce
Assist.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Unleash multiple attacks against enemies in front, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: "Capriccio"
Basic.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Perform up to three attacks forward, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
During the 3rd hit, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to charge, drawing enemies in and expanding the attack range for a stronger attack.
After using other skills, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to initiate the 3rd hit directly.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Interlude
Basic.desc:
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Release <color=#FFFFFF>Tremolo</color> forward to attack, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
A <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> will be triggered when this skill hits an enemy.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Chorus
Basic.desc:
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Launch multiple <color=#FFFFFF>Tremolo</color> attacks at enemies in front, dealing massive <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
A <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> will be triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Finale
Basic.desc:
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Release <color=#FFFFFF>Tremolo</color> forward to attack, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color> and exit the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state.
Upon activation of the skill, it grants Astra Yao the buff from <color=#FFFFFF>Core Passive: "Graceful Andante"</color>.
With enough Energy, consumes Energy to follow up with 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Tremolo</color> and 3 <color=#FFFFFF>Tone Clusters</color>. This <color=#FFFFFF>Tremolo</color> attack released is considered an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>.

Dodge.name: Dodge: "Mini Waltz"
Dodge.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Dodge.name: Dash Attack: "Lunar Eclipse Melody"
Dodge.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Attack ahead, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
When triggered, dragging the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} allows movement in the corresponding direction.

Dodge.name: Dodge Counter: "Umbrella Waltz"
Dodge.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Attack enemies in front, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Special.name: Special Attack: "Windchimes & Oaths"
Special.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Quickly move away, then release <color=#FFFFFF>Tremolo</color>, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>, and enter the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state.
During activation, dragging the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} enables movement in the direction held.
Hold <IconMap:Icon_Special> to charge during activation, drawing enemies in, and follow up with 1 to 4 <color=#FFFFFF>Tremolos</color> depending on the charge duration.
A <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> will be triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Character is invulnerable when quickly moving away.

Special.name: Idyllic Cadenza
Special.desc:
After entering the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state, Astra Yao increases all squad members' DMG by <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:0.08+AvatarSkillLevel(1)*0.01,100,2}%</color> and CRIT DMG by <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:0.07+AvatarSkillLevel(1)*0.015,100,2}%</color>.
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state, Astra Yao cannot move, but pressing <IconMap:Icon_Normal> will activate <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Interlude</color>, and pressing <IconMap:Icon_Evade> will activate a dodge. After triggering a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Chorus</color>.
While in this state, Astra Yao's Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, and the DMG she takes is reduced by 40%. After switching to another character, Astra Yao will remain on the field and become Invulnerable. When switching back to her, she will automatically follow up with <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: "Windchimes & Oaths"</color>.
During this state, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Finale</color>, exiting the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state, or hold <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to exit the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state directly.

Special.name: Chord
Special.desc:
For every 25 Energy, Astra Yao will have 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Chord</color>.
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state, when Astra Yao has <color=#FFFFFF>Chords</color>, a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> can be triggered in the following situations:
· When the active character's attack hits an enemy, once per 3s.
· When the active character's heavy attack hits an enemy, once per 1s.
When other squad members switch in through a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Evasive Assist</color>, Astra Yao will consume 25 Energy and release 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Tremolo</color> to attack. This <color=#FFFFFF>Tremolo</color> attack released is considered an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>.
After triggering a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, quickly press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to switch characters and trigger a <color=#FFFFFF>Precise Assist</color>, causing Astra Yao to follow up with 3 <color=#FFFFFF>Tone Clusters</color> to attack. When other squad members switch in through a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Evasive Assist</color>, it will automatically trigger a <color=#FFFFFF>Precise Assist</color>.

Chain.name: Chain Attack: "Tipsy Concerto"
Chain.desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Use song to channel energy into a blast, dealing massive <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
A <color=#ffffff>Quick Assist</color> is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
After the skill, Astra Yao enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state.

Chain.name: Ultimate: "Fantasian Sonata"
Chain.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Use song to channel energy into a blast, dealing massive <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>, and restoring <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:-50+AvatarSkillLevel(3)*250,1,2}</color> HP to all squad members.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
A <color=#ffffff>Quick Assist</color> is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
After the skill, Astra Yao enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state.
After the skill, the next two <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assists</color> will be replaced by <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attacks</color>.
Before all replacement chances are used up, a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> is triggered whenever any squad member hits an enemy with a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>.

Assist.name: Quick Assist: "One Luminous Sky"
Assist.desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Attack enemies in front, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Assist.name: Evasive Assist: "Two Hearts"
Assist.desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Dodges the enemy's attack and activates <color=#FFFFFF>Vital View</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Assist.name: Assist Follow-Up: "Three Lifetimes of Fate"
Assist.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after an <color=#FFFFFF>Evasive Assist</color> to activate:
Release an energy beam forward, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Razor Wire
Basic.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Launch up to five attacks ahead, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> and <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
When the 5th hit lands against an enemy, Evelyn will use her <color=#FFFFFF>Lunalux Garrote</color> to bind the primary target and enter <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color>.

Basic.name: Passive: Bind
Basic.desc:
When Evelyn uses her skills to deal DMG to enemies, she will accumulate <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Embers</color>.
When Evelyn consumes <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Embers</color> to activate <color=#FFFFFF>Garrote</color> or consumes <color=#FFFFFF>Decibels</color> to perform an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, she gains 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Tether Point</color>.
Once Evelyn has 3 <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Tether Points</color>, her next use of <color=#FFFFFF>Garrote</color> will consume all <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Tether Points</color> to instead use a lower Interrupt Level version of <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Lunalux - Snare</color>.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Garrote - First Form
Basic.desc:
When <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Embers</color> is at 50% or higher, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> or <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Consume 50% <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Embers</color> to use <color=#FFFFFF>Lunalux Garrote</color> to perform a slashing attack, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
After using this skill, gain 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Tether Point</color>.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Garrote - Second Form
Basic.desc:
When <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Embers</color> is 50% or higher, after using <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Garrote - First Form</color>, continue to hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> or <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Consume 50% <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Embers</color> to use <color=#FFFFFF>Lunalux Garrote</color> to perform a follow-up attack, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
After using this skill, gain 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Tether Point</color>.

Dodge.name: Dodge: Arc Step
Dodge.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Dodge.name: Dash Attack: Piercing Ambush
Dodge.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Deliver a kick to the enemy in front, causing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.

Dodge.name: Dodge Counter: Strangling Reversal
Dodge.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Use <color=#FFFFFF>Lunalux Garrote</color> to slash surrounding enemies, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>;
When the attack hits an enemy, Evelyn will use <color=#FFFFFF>Lunalux Garrote</color> to bind the primary target and enter <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Special.name: Special Attack: Locked Position
Special.desc:
Before entering <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Special> or <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Use <color=#FFFFFF>Lunalux Garrote</color> to pull the enemy and charge forward with a kick, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
When the attack hits the enemy, Evelyn will use <color=#FFFFFF>Lunalux Garrote</color> to bind the primary target and enter <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color>.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

Special.name: Special Attack: Binding Sunder - First Form
Special.desc:
After entering <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color>, press or hold <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Centered on the target affected by <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color>, tether surrounding enemies and detonate an explosion, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>. <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color> will end after detonation.
Dodge enemy attacks upon activating the skill, and if a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> is triggered, gain an additional 25% <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Embers</color>.
After tethering surrounding enemies, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to cancel detonation and immediately follow up with the <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack's</color> 3rd hit.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

Special.name: EX Special Attack: Binding Sunder - Final Form
Special.desc:
After entering <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color> and with enough Energy, press or hold <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Centered on the target affected by <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color>, tether surrounding enemies and detonate an explosion, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>. <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color> will end after detonation.
Dodge enemy attacks upon activating the skill, and if a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> is triggered, gain an additional 25% <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Embers</color>.
After pulling in surrounding enemies, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to cancel detonation and immediately follow up with the <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack's</color> 3rd hit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Special.name: Special Attack: Binding Sunder - First Form
EX Special Attack: Binding Sunder - Final Form

Chain.name: Chain Attack: Lunalux - Snare
Chain.desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Evelyn slashes in front with multiple <color=#FFFFFF>Lunalux Garrotes</color> and detonates an explosion, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> to enemies in the area.
When the attack hits an enemy, Evelyn uses <color=#FFFFFF>Lunalux Garrote</color> to bind the primary target and enters <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Chain.name: Ultimate: Lunalux Garrote - Timbre
Chain.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Evelyn slashes in front with multiple <color=#FFFFFF>Lunalux Garrotes</color> and detonates an explosion, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> to enemies in the area.
Upon activating this skill, Evelyn removes her jacket and enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Dance of Awakened Fire</color> state, which lasts for the entire battle. While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Dance of Awakened Fire</color> state, when Evelyn consumes <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Tether Points</color> to activate <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Lunalux - Snare</color>, she will retain 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Tether Point</color>. When the attack hits an enemy, Evelyn uses <color=#FFFFFF>Lunalux Garrote</color> to bind the primary target, entering <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, gain 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Tether Point</color>.

Chain.name: Ultimate: Lunalux Garrote - Shadow
Chain.desc:
While under the <color=#FFFFFF>Dance of Awakened Fire</color> state, and when Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Evelyn slashes in front with multiple <color=#FFFFFF>Lunalux Garrotes</color> and detonates an explosion, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> to enemies in the area.
When the attack hits an enemy, Evelyn uses <color=#FFFFFF>Lunalux Garrote</color> to bind the primary target and enters <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, gain 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Tether Point</color>.

Assist.name: Quick Assist: Fierce Blade
Assist.desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Use <color=#FFFFFF>Lunalux Garrote</color> to slash surrounding enemies, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
When the attack hits an enemy, Evelyn will use <color=#FFFFFF>Lunalux Garrote</color> to bind the primary target and enter <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Assist.name: Defensive Assist: Silent Protection
Assist.desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Assist.name: Assist Follow-Up: Course Disruption
Assist.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Evelyn slashes with <color=#FFFFFF>Lunalux Garrote</color>, then triggers an explosion ahead, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
When the attack hits an enemy, Evelyn will use <color=#FFFFFF>Lunalux Garrote</color> to bind the primary target and enter <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Feathered Strike
Basic.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Unleashes up to four attacks in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> and <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
After triggering the fourth attack, enter the <color=#FFFFFF>Noblewoman</color> state.
With <color=#FFFFFF>Flight Feathers</color> available, holding <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during the fourth attack will activate the <color=#FFFFFF>Fluttering Frock</color> state.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Noblewoman - Waltz
Basic.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> while in the <color=#FFFFFF>Noblewoman</color> state to activate:
Dash forward with an attack that deals <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color> and restores 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Flight Feather</color> upon hitting an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
If a Perfect Dodge is triggered during the dash, gain 1 additional <color=#FFFFFF>Flight Feather</color>.
If <color=#FFFFFF>Flight Feathers</color> are available after the skill, enter the <color=#FFFFFF>Fluttering Frock</color> state, which can be canceled by holding <IconMap:Icon_Evade> when the skill is used.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Fluttering Frock - Suspension
Basic.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> while in the <color=#FFFFFF>Fluttering Frock</color> state to activate:
Attack an area ahead, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
After activation, this skill consumes all <color=#FFFFFF>Flight Feathers</color>, and each one consumed grants 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Guard Feather</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When switching characters during the <color=#FFFFFF>Fluttering Frock</color> state, Vivian will automatically perform <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Fluttering Frock - Suspension</color>.
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Fluttering Frock</color> state, press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to exit the state.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Featherbloom
Basic.desc:
After any squad member hits a target with an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, Vivian will consume 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Guard Feather</color> to launch <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Featherbloom</color> against the target, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>, triggering at most once per use of a skill. This effect can trigger even while Vivian is off-field.
A maximum of 5 <color=#FFFFFF>Guard Feathers</color> can be stored.

Dodge.name: Dodge: Lightstream
Dodge.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Dodge.name: Dash Attack: Silver Thorned Melody
Dodge.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Launches a forward thrust at enemies in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.

Dodge.name: Dodge Counter: Wingblade Reverb
Dodge.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Launches an attack on enemies ahead, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> and <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After activating the skill, enter the <color=#FFFFFF>Noblewoman</color> state.
When there are <color=#FFFFFF>Flight Feathers</color> available, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during skill activation to enter the <color=#FFFFFF>Fluttering Frock</color> state.

Dodge.name: Dodge: Dainty Steps
Dodge.desc:
When in the <color=#FFFFFF>Noblewoman</color> state and about to be attacked, an automatic dodge will trigger, during which the character will be Invulnerable, but a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> will not be triggered.
This can trigger once each time the <color=#FFFFFF>Noblewoman</color> state is entered.

Special.name: Special Attack: Song of Silver Wings
Special.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Quickly attack forward, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> and <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

Special.name: EX Special Attack: Violet Requiem
Special.desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Unleash a powerful forward attack that deals massive <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color> and grants 3 <color=#FFFFFF>Flight Feathers</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Enter the <color=#FFFFFF>Fluttering Frock</color> state after using the skill. Hold <IconMap:Icon_Evade> during the skill to enter the <color=#FFFFFF>Noblewoman</color> state.

Special.name: Special Attack: Song of Silver Wings

Chain.name: Chain Attack: Chorus of Celestial Wings
Chain.desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Launch a powerful attack on a large area of enemies ahead, dealing massive <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color> and gaining 2 <color=#FFFFFF>Flight Feathers</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After the skill activates, enter the <color=#FFFFFF>Fluttering Frock</color> state, which can be canceled by holding <IconMap:Icon_Evade> during the skill.

Chain.name: Ultimate: Soaring Bird's Song
Chain.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Launch a powerful attack on a large area of enemies ahead, dealing massive <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color> and gaining 5 <color=#FFFFFF>Flight Feathers</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After the skill is activated, enter the <color=#FFFFFF>Fluttering Frock</color> state, which can be canceled by holding <IconMap:Icon_Evade> during the skill.

Chain.name: Chain Attack: Chorus of Celestial Wings

Assist.name: Quick Assist: Frostwing Guard
Assist.desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Launches an attack on enemies ahead, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> and <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After the skill activates, enter the <color=#FFFFFF>Noblewoman</color> state.
With <color=#FFFFFF>Flight Feathers</color> available, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during skill activation to enter the <color=#FFFFFF>Fluttering Frock</color> state.

Assist.name: Defensive Assist: Silver Umbrella Formation
Assist.desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Assist.name: Assist Follow-Up: Featherblade Execution
Assist.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Launch an attack at enemies ahead, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color> and gaining 2 <color=#FFFFFF>Flight Feathers</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After the skill activates enter the <color=#FFFFFF>Fluttering Frock</color> state, which can be canceled by holding <IconMap:Icon_Evade> during the skill.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Glacial Judgment
Basic.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Launches up to five slashes forward, the first dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>, and the following four <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Final Verdict
Basic.desc:
Hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
After getting ready, Zhao starts charging up, then launches a forward slash on release, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
While charging, Zhao accumulates up to 5s of charge time. When the Finishing Move of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Final Verdict</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color> hits, the stored charge time is consumed to deal additional DMG. For every 1 second of charge time, Zhao deals <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:0.12+AvatarSkillLevel(0)*0.01,100,2}%</color> of Max HP as additional DMG.
When Zhao is in any <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil</color>, if she gets switched out while charging, the charge can continue.
If <color=#FFFFFF>Frostbite Points</color> are maxed out when the skill activates, all <color=#FFFFFF>Frostbite Points</color> are consumed to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color> and a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>. If a squadmate is then switched in via <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, Zhao automatically follows up with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Final Verdict</color> and begins charging.
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
While not the currently controlled character, the character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Dodge.name: Dodge: Bunny Hop
Dodge.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Dodge.name: Dash Attack: Bouncing Dash
Dodge.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Slashes forward, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> and <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.

Dodge.name: Dodge Counter: Swift Blink
Dodge.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Performs a falling slash ahead, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Special.name: Special Attack: Shatterfrost Surge
Special.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Launches a forward slash, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Upon activating this skill, consumes 5% of current HP to grant all squad members HP regeneration equal to <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:1+AvatarSkillLevel(1)*0.06,1,2}%</color> of Zhao's Max HP per second for 5s. The HP-consuming effects of <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Shatterfrost Surge</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Frostflow Tundra</color> can trigger at most once every 30s.

Special.name: EX Special Attack: Frostflow Tundra
Special.desc:
With enough energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Launches multiple forward slashes, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Upon activating this skill, consumes 5% of current HP to grant all squad members HP regeneration equal to <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:1+AvatarSkillLevel(1)*0.06,1,2}%</color> of Zhao's Max HP per second for 5s. The HP-consuming effects of <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Shatterfrost Surge</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Frostflow Tundra</color> can trigger at most once every 30s.
Upon activating this skill, gain 20 <color=#FFFFFF>Frostbite Points</color>. If <color=#FFFFFF>Frostbite Points</color> are maxed out, all <color=#FFFFFF>Frostbite Points</color> are consumed to activate <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color>.
Upon activating this skill while in any <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil</color>, a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> is triggered. If a squadmate is then switched in via <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, Zhao automatically follows up with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Final Verdict</color> and begins charging.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Chain.name: Chain Attack: Temporary Alliance
Chain.desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Launches multiple slashes in front, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
After using this skill, gains 5 <color=#FFFFFF>Frostbite Points</color>. If <color=#FFFFFF>Frostbite Points</color> are maxed out, all <color=#FFFFFF>Frostbite Points</color> are consumed to activate <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color>.
Upon activating this skill while in any <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil</color>, a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> is triggered. If a squadmate is then switched in via <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, Zhao automatically follows up with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Final Verdict</color> and begins charging.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Chain.name: Ultimate: Bunny Barrage
Chain.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Launches consecutive attacks in front, followed by a falling slash, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
After using this skill, gains 20 <color=#FFFFFF>Frostbite Points</color>. If <color=#FFFFFF>Frostbite Points</color> are maxed out, all <color=#FFFFFF>Frostbite Points</color> are consumed to activate <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color>.
Upon activating this skill while in any <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil</color>, a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> is triggered. If a squadmate is then switched in via <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, Zhao automatically follows up with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Final Verdict</color> and begins charging.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Assist.name: Entry Skill: Burst of Frost
Assist.desc:
When Zhao has maximum <color=#FFFFFF>Frostbite Points</color>, and is in combat, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Launches consecutive attacks forward, followed by a slash, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Upon activating this skill, all <color=#FFFFFF>Frostbite Points</color> are consumed to activate <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color>.
Upon activating this skill, a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> is triggered. If a squadmate is then switched in via <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, Zhao automatically follows up with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Final Verdict</color> and begins charging.
Activating this skill is considered as activating a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Assist.name: Quick Assist: Patch the Gaps
Assist.desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Launches a falling slash in front, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Assist.name: Defensive Assist: Frostveil Suppression
Assist.desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Points</color> when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Assist.name: Assist Follow-Up: Frostlight Reflection
Assist.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Launch multiple slashes in front, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Upon activating this skill, if <color=#FFFFFF>Frostbite Points</color> are maxed out, all <color=#FFFFFF>Frostbite Points</color> are consumed to activate <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color>.
Upon activating this skill while in any <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil</color>, a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> is triggered. If a squadmate is then switched in via <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, Zhao automatically follows up with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Final Verdict</color> and begins charging.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Swift Strike
Basic.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Unleashes up to 3 attacks forward, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Leaping Strike
Basic.desc:
Hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Leap forward and unleash a series of slashes, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.

Dodge.name: Dodge: Reversal Shot
Dodge.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Dodge.name: Dash Attack: First Strike Advantage
Dodge.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Dash forward and slash, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.

Dodge.name: Dodge Counter: Relentless Retribution
Dodge.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Thrust at enemies in front, then follow up with a swift slash, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Special.name: Special Attack: Rending Claw
Special.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Perform a rapid back-and-forth piercing attack, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

Special.name: Special Attack: Rending Claw - Nightmare Shadow
Special.desc:
While Pulchra is in the <color=#FFFFFF>Hunter's Gait</color> state, and when another active character in the squad hits an enemy with a heavy attack from a <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>:
Dash back-and-forth piercing enemies centered on the target, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
After using this skill, if another active character in the squad hits an enemy, Pulchra will repeat the attack up to 5 additional times, with the final attack being a more powerful Finishing Move.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
<color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Rending Claw - Nightmare Shadow</color> is an <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color> attack.

Special.name: EX Special Attack: Rending Claw - Flashstep
Special.desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Pierce back and forth times, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Special.name: Special Attack: Rending Claw - Nightmare Shadow
EX Special Attack: Rending Claw - Flashstep

Chain.name: Chain Attack: Hey, Didn't Expect That, Right?
Chain.desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a charged shot forward, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Chain.name: Ultimate: Oh, Time to Play?
Chain.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Unleash a powerful shot at enemies in a large area ahead, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Chain.name: Chain Attack: Hey, Didn't Expect That, Right?

Assist.name: Quick Assist: Contract - Bodyguard
Assist.desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Thrust at enemies in front, followed by rapid slashes, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Assist.name: Evasive Assist: Contract - Outsourced Combat
Assist.desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Dodges the enemy's attack and activates <color=#FFFFFF>Vital View</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Assist.name: Assist Follow-Up: Independent Pricing
Assist.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after an <color=#FFFFFF>Evasive Assist</color> to activate:
Leap forward into the air and fire, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Upon activating this skill, consume 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Point</color> to enter the <color=#FFFFFF>Hunter's Gait</color> state.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Cold-Bore Shot
Basic.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Unleashes up to 4 shots ahead. The first 3 hits deal <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>, the 4th hit deals <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Silenced Shot
Basic.desc:
Hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Trigger enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Sniper Stance</color> and fires forward continuously, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
While continually firing, when attacked by an enemy, Trigger will automatically evade. This effect can trigger once every 8s.
While continually firing, you can drag the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} to adjust her position to the left/right/back.
Automatically evading attacks or adjusting position when about to be hit will trigger a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>, followed by an automatic charged counter.
After releasing <IconMap:Icon_Normal>, Trigger will step back, ready her weapon and unleash a Finishing Move, then exit <color=#FFFFFF>Sniper Stance</color>.
Character is invulnerable during the charged counter and Finishing Move.
When the continuous firing or the charged counter hits an enemy, Trigger gains 25 <color=#FFFFFF>Purge</color>, up to a maximum of 100 <color=#FFFFFF>Purge</color>.
When the Finishing Move hits an enemy, it triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> of the previous character in the squad. A <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> can only be triggered through this method once every 25s.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot
Basic.desc:
When Trigger has <color=#FFFFFF>Purge</color>, use another active character in the squad to hit an enemy with a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> to activate:
While encircling the enemy, rapidly fire two shots at the enemy, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Upon activating this skill, consume 3 <color=#FFFFFF>Purge</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
<color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot</color> is an <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color> attack.
The squad can trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot</color> once every 3s.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot - Tartarus
Basic.desc:
When Trigger has <color=#FFFFFF>Purge</color>, use another active character in the squad to hit an enemy with a heavy attack from an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> to activate:
While encircling the enemy, rapidly fires three shots at the enemy, followed by a Finishing Move, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Upon activating this skill, consume 5 <color=#FFFFFF>Purge</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
<color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot - Tartarus</color> is an <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color> attack.
The same skill type can trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot - Tartarus</color> up to 2 times within 20s for the entire squad.
During <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot - Tartarus</color> will immediately activate instead if triggered.

Dodge.name: Dodge: Phantom Concealment
Dodge.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Dodge.name: Dash Attack: Vengeful Specter
Dodge.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Rapidly lift the gun and fire, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.

Dodge.name: Dodge Counter: Condemned Soul
Dodge.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Rotate and fire a quick shot at enemies in front, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Special.name: Special Attack: Spectral Flash
Special.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Lunge forward with a slash, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

Special.name: EX Special Attack: Flash Burial
Special.desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Lunge forward with a slash, then leap up with a powerful shot to the ground, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When this skill hits an enemy, it triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> of the previous character in the squad.
When this skill hits an enemy, Trigger enters <color=#FFFFFF>Coordinated Support</color>. While in this state, when another active character in the squad hits an enemy with any attack, it triggers a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot</color> without consuming <color=#FFFFFF>Purge</color> and with no cooldown restrictions. This state lasts 8s and the effect can trigger up to 4 times. Repeatedly entering <color=#FFFFFF>Coordinated Support</color> extends the duration and grants additional triggers, lasting a maximum of 20s and triggering up to a maximum of 10 times.

Chain.name: Chain Attack: Stygian Guide
Chain.desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes continuous powerful shots forward, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Chain.name: Ultimate: Underworld Requiem
Chain.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Deliver a powerful shot at enemies in a large area ahead, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When the skill hits an enemy, it triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> of the previous character in the squad.
When the skill hits an enemy, Trigger enters <color=#FFFFFF>Coordinated Support</color>. While in this state, when another active character in the squad hits an enemy with any attack, it triggers a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot</color> without consuming <color=#FFFFFF>Purge</color> and with no cooldown restrictions. This state lasts 12s and the effect can trigger up to 6 times. Repeatedly entering <color=#FFFFFF>Coordinated Support</color> extends the duration and grants additional triggers, lasting a maximum of 20s and triggering up to a maximum of 10 times.

Assist.name: Quick Assist: Cold-Bore Cover Fire
Assist.desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Rotate and fire a quick shot at enemies in front, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Assist.name: Defensive Assist: Delaying Demise
Assist.desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Assist.name: Assist Follow-Up: Piercing Thunder
Assist.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Unleash a series of slashes at enemies ahead, followed by a powerful charged shot after landing, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Cirrus Strike
Basic.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Perform up to five attacks forward, dealing <color=#FE437E>Auric Ink DMG</color>.
This skill's Anti-Interrupt Level increases during the 3rd and 4th hit.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Ink‐Veil Cloud Coalescence
Basic.desc:
Hold <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
Deploy a Grand Tai Chi Formation, dealing <color=#FE437E>Auric Ink DMG</color>.
When the skill ends, automatically launch the 5th hit of Basic Attack: Cirrus Strike.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill, and DMG received is reduced by 40%.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Auric Array
Basic.desc:
While possessing an Auric Ink Point: tap <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during Dodge: Nimbus Step, or hold <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
Deploy an array, continuously dealing <color=#FE437E>Auric Ink DMG</color>.
When the skill ends, it automatically triggers Basic Attack: Qingming Eruption.
While channeling, continuously recover Adrenaline, recovering 7/s, for up to 3s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill, and enters the Vital View state.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Qingming Eruption
Basic.desc:
Automatically activates when Basic Attack: Auric Array reaches the max duration:
Spreads her wings to launch an explosive attack, dealing massive <color=#FE437E>Auric Ink DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Dodge.name: Dodge: Hidden Cloud Technique
Dodge.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Dodge.name: Dash Attack: Skybreaker
Dodge.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Launch a forward rush attack, dealing <color=#FE437E>Auric Ink DMG</color>.

Dodge.name: Dodge: Nimbus Step
Dodge.desc:
When dragging the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick}, hold <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
Enter a high‐speed <color=#FFFFFF>Light as Air</color> state. While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Light as Air</color> state in Investigation Zone Mode, automatically collect from all resource pickup points within range.
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Light as Air</color> state, use the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} to steer. Release the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} to stop.
Character is invulnerable at the moment this skill activates.

Dodge.name: Dodge Counter: Banishing Blow
Dodge.desc:

Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Special.name: Special Attack: Shadow-Ignition
Special.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Swiftly retreat, then attack forward, dealing <color=#FE437E>Auric Ink DMG</color>.
While retreating, a Perfect Dodge can be triggered, but cannot be followed up with a Dodge Counter.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

Special.name: EX Special Attack: Ink Manifestation
Special.desc:
With enough Adrenaline, press or hold <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Rp> to activate:
Charge continuously, and release <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Rp> to launch an upward wing attack, dealing massive <color=#FE437E>Auric Ink DMG</color>.
While charging, incoming attacks are automatically blocked and will activate the upward wing attack.
If hit at the exact moment charging begins, it triggers a Perfect Block effect, negating the DMG and increasing the skill's Interrupt Level to match a Heavy Defensive Assist, and recovering 10 Adrenaline.
When an upward wing strike hits an enemy with a red flash or yellow flash, a Perfect Block can be triggered, negating the hit and increasing the skill's Interrupt Level to match a Defensive Assist and recovering 10 Adrenaline.
The Perfect Block effect can occur at most once every 0.5s.
If charged until flashing or when triggering the Perfect Block effect, the upward wing attack can be followed by an additional Talisman Attack.
After the skill, press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to launch EX Special Attack: Celestial Cloud Blitz - Break.
After EX Special Attack: Celestial Cloud Blitz - Break, and with enough Adrenaline, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Rp> to consume another 20 Adrenaline to launch EX Special Attack: Qingming Eruption - Break.
After using EX Special Attack: Qingming Eruption - Break and with enough Auric Ink Points, hold <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to quickly follow up with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Auric Array</color>.
Character is invulnerable during the upward wing attack, and Anti-Interrupt Level is increased while charging.

Special.name: EX Special Attack: Cloud-Shaper
Special.desc:
With enough Adrenaline, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Continuously charge up, channeling energy around enemies to deal DMG over time, up to a max of 2s, dealing massive <color=#FE437E>Auric Ink DMG</color>.
Once fully charged or if interrupted, automatically trigger EX Special Attack: Ashen Ink Becomes Shadows.
At the moment the skill is activated, a Perfect Dodge can be triggered. After the Perfect Dodge, enter the Vital View state.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Special.name: EX Special Attack: Ashen Ink Becomes Shadows
Special.desc:

When the energy orb appears and contracts, it deals <color=#FE437E>Auric Ink DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Special.name: EX Special Attack: Ashen Ink Becomes Shadows

Upon activating this skill, Yixuan evenly redistributes the squad's HP.
After using this skill and with enough Auric Ink Points, hold <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to quickly follow up with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Auric Array</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Chain.name: Ultimate: Endless Talisman Suppression
Chain.desc:
With enough Technique Points, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Consumes 120 Technique Points to spread her wings, then guide countless talismans to attack, dealing massive <color=#FE437E>Auric Ink DMG</color>.
With both enough Technique Points and Decibels, this skill triggers with priority.
After using this skill and with enough Auric Ink Points, hold <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to quickly follow up with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Auric Array</color>.
Upon activating this skill, Yixuan evenly redistributes the squad's HP.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

After the 4th attack hits the enemy, repeatedly press or hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to quickly pass through enemies in front up to 5 times.

Dodge.name: Dodge Counter: Ground Flash Counter

Dodge.name: Dodge Counter: Ground Flash Counter
Dodge.desc:

While in the Voltage Overload state, dodge performance is enhanced. Additionally, when using Basic Attack/Dash Attack/Dodge Counter, if the enemy target has <color=#FFFFFF>White Thunder</color>, pressing <IconMap:Icon_Special> will immediately cancel the current skill and launch <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Azure Flash</color>.
While in this state, if the enemy does not have <color=#FFFFFF>White Thunder</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to directly launch EX Special Attack: Sundering Bolt.

Special.name: Special Attack: Azure Flash

When Soldier 0 - Anby's attacks hit an enemy, they apply the <color=#FFFFFF>Silver Star</color> mark and charges the target 
For every one-third of charge, the enemy receives 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>White Thunder</color>, stacking up to 3 times.
When the enemy has <color=#FFFFFF>White Thunder</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Quickly dash forward, slashing through enemies and dealing multiple hits of <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
When the skill hits an enemy, it will consume 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>White Thunder</color> to trigger an <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color> that deals 1 extra instance of <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Special.name: Special Attack: Thunder Smite
Special.desc:
When the additional damage from <color=#FFFFFF>White Thunder</color> triggers 3 times on the same enemy:
A lightning strike will fall at the enemy's location, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> to enemies within range.
This DMG is considered <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color> DMG.

Special.name: Special Attack: Azure Flash - Boundary
Special.desc:
When <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Thunder Smite</color> DMG is triggered:
If EX Special Attack: Sundering Bolt or Special Attack: Azure Flash is currently being used, then <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Azure Flash - Boundary</color> will automatically trigger when the current skill ends, unleashing a flurry of slashes that deal multiple instances of <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>. This skill counts as an <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

During the 3rd hit, repeatedly press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to maintain the combo and keep striking the enemy.
During the 3rd hit, hold or pause before pressing <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to chain into the 4th hit.
During the 3rd hit, Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, and DMG received is reduced by 40%.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Hu Wei
Basic.desc:
During combat, Hu Wei will automatically attack enemies, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Upon hitting an enemy, gain 20 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Might</color>, triggering up to once per use of a skill. The maximum for <color=#FFFFFF>Might</color> is 200.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Tiger Seven Forms - Flaming Claw

Dodge.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.

Dodge.name: Dash Attack: Tiger Seven Forms - Mountain King's Game
Dodge.desc:
After using <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Tiger Seven Forms - Tiger Charge</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Enter a high-speed spinning state. While in this state, use the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} to move and deal <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> upon contact with enemies.
After Ju Fufu gains <color=#FFFFFF>Momentum</color> from other skills, she will be surrounded by flames in the high-speed spinning state. Upon contact with enemies, 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Momentum</color> is consumed, changing the DMG to <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> and granting 25 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Might</color>. The maximum for <color=#FFFFFF>Momentum</color> is 15.
When consuming <color=#FFFFFF>Momentum</color> to deal <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>, if <color=#FFFFFF>Might</color> is above 100 points, 100 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Might</color> will be automatically consumed to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Suppressing Tiger Cauldron</color>.
Releasing <IconMap:Icon_Normal> will have Ju Fufu exit the spinning state and throw <color=#FFFFFF>Hu Wei</color> to attack enemies, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>. When switching to another character, Ju Fufu will remain in the spinning state and attempt to collide with the nearest enemy.
While Ju Fufu is the currently active character, DMG taken during the skill is reduced by 40%, and Anti-Interrupt Level is increased. If not the active character, she becomes Invulnerable.

Dodge.name: Dodge Counter: Tiger Seven Forms - Reignited Mountain

Hold to charge, expending up to 3 bars of <color=#FFFFFF>Blade Etiquette</color>. Release <IconMap:Icon_Normal> or when <color=#FFFFFF>Blade Etiquette</color> is below 1 bar, Alice performs a series of slashes in an area centered on the target enemy, with the number of hits determined by charge level, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
When the Finishing Move of a three-stage charged <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Starshine Waltz</color> hits, it triggers a special <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color> effect: <color=#F0D12B>Polarity Assault</color>. This deals DMG equal to {CAL:0+100,1,2}% of the original <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color>, ignoring Anomaly Buildup, and can interact with other Attribute Anomalies, including Physical, to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color>.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Tanuki Claws
Basic.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Unleashes up to 5 strikes ahead, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Tanuki Cloak
Basic.desc:
Hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Enter a defensive stance for up to 1.5 seconds. If hit during this time, parry the attack and inflict massive Daze against the attacking enemy.
Successfully parrying an attack gains 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Sugar Points</color>.
Character is invulnerable when successfully parrying.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Hard Candy Shot
Basic.desc:
When Yuzuha has <color=#FFFFFF>Sugar Points</color>, landing a hit with other active characters' attacks will have Yuzuha continuously twirl her umbrella and attack centered around the target before launching a powerful shell, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>. When this attack lands a heavy attack, Yuzuha consumes 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Sugar Point</color>.
<color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Hard Candy Shot</color> is considered an <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color>.
<color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Hard Candy Shot</color> can be triggered once every 8s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles
Basic.desc:
Enemies under the effect of <color=#FFFFFF>Sweet Scare</color> will be attacked by a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles</color> once every 1s.
<color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles</color> initially deals <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
<color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles</color> does not contribute its accumulated Attribute Anomaly Buildup toward Anomaly DMG calculation.
<color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles</color> Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:0.07+AvatarSkillLevel(0)*0.015,100,4}%</color>.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max
Basic.desc:
Enemies affected by <color=#FFFFFF>Sweet Scare</color> will be attacked by a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max</color> when hit with a heavy attack from <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Hard Candy Shot</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up: Stuffed Hard Candy Shot</color>.
<color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max</color> initially deals <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
<color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max</color> does not contribute its accumulated Attribute Anomaly Buildup toward Anomaly DMG calculation.
<color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max</color> Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:0.07+AvatarSkillLevel(0)*0.015,100,4}%</color>.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Tanuki Helper
Basic.desc:
When Yuzuha is off-field, tanuki Kama assists the active character in attacking enemies, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
When Yuzuha performs <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Tanuki Cloak</color>, tanuki Kama joins her in attacking the enemy, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Tanuki Kama inherits Yuzuha's initial ATK.

Dodge.name: Dodge: Did I Scare You?
Dodge.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Dodge.name: Dash Attack: You're Outta Luck!
Dodge.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Rapidly strikes enemies in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.

Dodge.name: Dodge Counter: Time for Payback~
Dodge.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Deliver a quick strike forward, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Special.name: Special Attack: Gummy Bombardment
Special.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Fire a cannon shot forward, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.

Special.name: EX Special Attack: Cavity Alert
Special.desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Throw a bomb at the enemy, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Upon hitting an enemy with a heavy attack, it inflicts the <color=#FFFFFF>Sweet Scare</color> state.
Gains 2 <color=#FFFFFF>Sugar Points</color> upon activation.
A <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Special.name: EX Special Attack: Cavity Alert, Right Now!
Special.desc:
After using <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter: Time for Payback~</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist: Dessert Time</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up: We Have Cookies</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up: Stuffed Hard Candy Shot</color>, or when a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> is triggered, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Quickly throw a bomb at the enemy, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
On hitting an enemy with a heavy attack, it inflicts the <color=#FFFFFF>Sweet Scare</color> state.
Gains 2 <color=#FFFFFF>Sugar Points</color> upon activation.
A <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Special.name: Sweet Scare
Special.desc:
The <color=#FFFFFF>Sweet Scare</color> state lasts for <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:16+AvatarSkillLevel(1)*2,1,2}</color>s, repeated triggers reset the duration.
When an enemy affected by <color=#FFFFFF>Sweet Scare</color> is first hit by an active character using an attack of their attribute, <color=#FFFFFF>Flavor Match</color> is triggered against that enemy, changing the attribute of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max</color> against that enemy to match that of the character who triggered Flavor Match.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Sweet Scare</color> is triggered again on an enemy, their existing <color=#FFFFFF>Flavor Match</color> state is removed. The process can be repeated to change the attribute of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max</color> again.

Special.name: EX Special Attack: Cavity Alert, Right Now!

Chain.name: Chain Attack: Prank Assault
Chain.desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleash a powerful strike on enemies in a small area ahead, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Gains 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Sugar Points</color> when used.
A <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Chain.name: Ultimate: Surrender or Suffer the Mischief
Chain.desc:
When Decibel Rating reaches Maximum, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to trigger:
Unleash a powerful strike on enemies in a large area around the character, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Enemies hit with a heavy attack are inflicted with the <color=#FFFFFF>Sweet Scare</color> state.
Upon activating this skill, other squad members gain <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:7+AvatarSkillLevel(3)*1.5,1,2}</color> Energy.
Upon activating this skill, gain 2 <color=#FFFFFF>Sugar Points</color>.
A <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Chain.name: Ultimate: Surrender or Suffer the Mischief

Assist.name: Quick Assist: Dessert Time
Assist.desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Strike enemies in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Assist.name: Defensive Assist: Replenish Your Fun
Assist.desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Upon a successful parry, gain 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Sugar Points</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Assist.name: Assist Follow-Up: We Have Cookies
Assist.desc:
After triggering a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> or successfully parrying an enemy attack with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Tanuki Cloak</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Strike enemies in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Assist.name: Assist Follow-Up: Stuffed Hard Candy Shot
Assist.desc:
After triggering a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> or successfully parrying an enemy attack with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Tanuki Cloak</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> at the right moment to activate:
Following a continuous spinning umbrella attack, fire a powerful projectile that deals <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Assist.name: Assist Follow-Up: Stuffed Hard Candy Shot

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Unyielding Strikes
Basic.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Launches up to four consecutive melee attacks, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.

Dodge.name: Dodge: Light as a Swallow
Dodge.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.

Perform a quick forward melee attack, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.

Dodge.name: Dodge Counter: Moving Mountains and Seas
Dodge.desc:

Perform a melee attack on enemies in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
