Special.name: Special Attack: Sonic Pressure-Point Strike
Special.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Delivers a forward melee technique while tossing firecrackers, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

Special.name: Special Attack: Touch of Death
Special.desc:
With <color=#FFFFFF>Break Force</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Special>to activate:
<color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Touch of Death</color> attacks centered on the enemy, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
The skill can be chained up to three times. Each use of <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Touch of Death</color> consumes 1 point of Break Force.
When Pan Yinhu is the active character, DMG received during the skill is reduced by 40% and Anti-Interrupt Level is increased. If he isn't the active character, he becomes Invulnerable.

Special.name: EX Special Attack: Mountainous Pulse Strike
Special.desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
<color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Mountainous Pulse Strike</color> unleashes a powerful strike forward, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Gain 3 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Break Force</color> on activation. Upon hitting an enemy, it triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> of the previous character in the squad.
Agents who enter the field via this Quick Assist will gain the Sheer Force bonus from the Core Passive. After switching out, Pan Yinhu will stay on the field and automatically launch <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Touch of Death</color> until his Break Force runs out, where he then leaves the field.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Special.name: EX Special Attack: Mountainous Pulse Strike

Chain.name: Chain Attack: Anointed with Wok Steam
Chain.desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Hop onto the Iron Wok and spin rapidly to ram into enemies, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> to all enemies on the way.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Chain.name: Ultimate: A Feast Fit for an Emperor!
Chain.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Perform a technique that compresses qi into fried rice and catapults it at foes, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> and healing all squad members for <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:100+AvatarSkillLevel(3)*60,1,2}</color> HP, while also applying a 8s heal over time on all squad members, recovering <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:0.8+AvatarSkillLevel(3)*0.05,1,2}</color>% HP/s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Chain.name: Chain Attack: Anointed with Wok Steam
Ultimate: A Feast Fit for an Emperor!

Assist.name: Quick Assist: Lift Your Gaze to Good Fortune
Assist.desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Perform a melee attack on enemies in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Assist.name: Defensive Assist: Intimidating Presence
Assist.desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Points</color> when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Assist.name: Assist Follow-Up: Ride the Momentum
Assist.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Perform a melee attack on enemies in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Assist.name: Quick Assist: Lift Your Gaze to Good Fortune

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Swiftedge
Basic.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Launches up to four forward slashes, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Can be chained into <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Phantasm Dash</color> after the 4th hit.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Cloudstream Sword Will
Basic.desc:
Hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Launches a flurry of blade shockwaves, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>. Hold to extend the attack.
Anti-Interrupt Level is increased during this skill.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Splitting Currents
Basic.desc:
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state and on the ground, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Performs up to three forward slashes, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
If struck by an enemy attack during the 3rd hit, triggers a block, negating that instance of DMG.
If she possesses <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color>, the 3rd hit is replaced with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Skyward Ascent</color>.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Skyward Ascent
Basic.desc:
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state and with <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color>, after the 2nd hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Splitting Currents</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Launches a swift rising attack, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> and entering an airborne state.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Maximum
Basic.desc:
After activating <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Annihilation</color>, and with <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Launches a wide sweeping slash forward, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>. On hit, 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> is consumed.
If struck by an enemy during the skill, triggers a block, negating that instance of DMG and increasing the skill's Interrupt Level.
After using this skill and with <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to consume 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> and launch a hit of <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Soaring Light</color>. This skill is automatically followed up with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Skyward Ascent</color>, and Ye Shunguang enters an airborne state.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight
Basic.desc:
In the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state, and while airborne, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Launches up to two downward slashes in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Ye Shunguang will not exit the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state during this skill.
Press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> or <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to follow up with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Annihilation</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Annihilation
Basic.desc:
After the 2nd hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Performs a falling attack in front, entering a grounded state, and dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
When launching this skill with 2 or more points of <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color>, Ye Shunguang will perform a downward falling strike across a large area in front instead, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>. On hit, 2 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> are consumed, granting the <color=#FFFFFF>Culmination</color> effect. After using this skill, if Ye Shunguang possesses <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to consume 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> and launch a hit of <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Soaring Light</color>, which can be quickly followed up with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Maximum</color>.
Ye Shunguang will not exit the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state during this skill.
During this skill, if attacked by enemies, triggers a block, negating that instance of DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Basic.name: Culmination
Basic.desc: During <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Soaring Light</color>, each time <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> is consumed while <color=#FFFFFF>Culmination</color> is active, the <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> cost is replaced by consuming <color=#FFFFFF>Culmination</color> instead. This effect does not stack, and lasts until the current <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> ends.

Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Maximum
Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Annihilation

Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
During the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state, and if a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> is triggered, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Skyward Ascent</color>.

Dodge.name: Dodge: Wandering Cloud
Dodge.desc:
While tilting the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick}, hold <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
Enters a high-speed movement state. Steer with the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick}, and release the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} to stop.

Dodge.name: Dash Attack: Phantasm Dash
Dodge.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.

Dodge.name: Dodge Counter: Swallow Strike
Dodge.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Leaps into the air and thrusts forward, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Special.name: Special Attack: Guiding Tides
Special.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
If a dodge is available, 1 dodge chance is consumed, and the action is counted as activating a <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge</color>.
If no dodge is available or a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> is not triggered, launches a quick sword energy attack that deals <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
If a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> is triggered at this time, launches a flying sword attack, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>, and immediately follow up with the 2nd hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Swiftedge</color>.
Character is briefly invulnerable during the skill.

Special.name: EX Special Attack: Gale Suppression
Special.desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Launches a rushing slash and a flying sword attack at the enemy, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Enemy attacks can be dodged during this skill.
After this skill is used, gain 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Special.name: Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Clean Exit
Special.desc:
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state and grounded, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Performs a swift backstep slash, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
If a dodge is available, 1 dodge chance is consumed, and the action is counted as activating a <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge</color>.
If a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> is triggered at this time, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to quickly activate <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Maximum</color> and enter <color=#FFFFFF>Vital View</color>.
After this <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Maximum</color> activates, it can be immediately followed up with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Skyward Ascent</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Special.name: EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Soaring Light
Special.desc:
In the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state and with <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Performs quick consecutive slashes, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> while rapidly consuming <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> until none remains.
The skill ends early if <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> is insufficient or if <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> is released.
Ye Shunguang will not exit the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state during this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Special.name: EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Return to Dust
Special.desc:
In the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> or hold <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> when all <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> is expended to activate:
Deals massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> to enemies in a large area.
Ye Shunguang will not exit the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state during this skill.
After using this skill, <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Verdict</color> is removed and the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state ends.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Return to Dust

Unleashes a powerful slash at enemies ahead in a large area, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Chain.name: Ultimate: Chasing Storms
Chain.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Summons a sword formation and enter the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state, activating an <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Verdict</color> while also gaining 6 <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color>. This skill deals massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Upon activating this skill, if Decibels are consumed, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> while in this <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state to launch an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Cleaving Heavens</color> that doesn't consume Decibels.
Enter the airborne state after using this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Chain.name: Chain Attack: Enlightened Mind - Lure Thunder
Chain.desc:
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state, and when a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful slash at enemies ahead in a large area, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Ye Shunguang will not exit the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state during this skill.
Enter the airborne state after using this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Chain.name: Ultimate: Cleaving Heavens
Chain.desc:
After consuming Decibels to launch <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Chasing Storms</color> and while in the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> or hold <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> when all <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> is expended to activate:
Summons a massive blade, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> to enemies.
Ye Shunguang will not exit the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state during this skill.
After using this skill, the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state ends, and <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Verdict</color> is removed.
This skill doesn't consume Decibels.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Chain.name: Chain Attack: Enlightened Mind - Lure Thunder

Assist.name: Entry Skill: Illuminating Darkness
Assist.desc:
With 6 <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> and while not in the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate, or press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> while in combat and switch on-field from off-field to activate:
Enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state and activates <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Verdict</color>.
Deals <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> to enemies in a large area in front.
Activating this skill is considered as activating a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>.
Enters the airborne state after using this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Assist.name: Quick Assist: Support Guard
Assist.desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Leaps into the air and thrusts forward, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Assist.name: Assist Follow-Up: Cease Hostility
Assist.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Deals massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Assist.name: Defensive Assist: When I Return
Assist.desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:

Deals massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.

Basic.desc:

Perform up to three forward slashes, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
During each slash, pressing <IconMap:Icon_Special> triggers Scorchwind, causing the attack to deal increased <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Blazing Wind - Misty Slash
Basic.desc:
While in the Molten Edge state, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Unleash up to four forward slashes, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
If Manato's HP is above 30% when the skill is activated, 3.5% of his Max HP will be consumed.

Dodge.desc:

Special.name: Special Attack: Return to Ashes
Special.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Slash forward at enemies, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
If hit by an enemy during the skill, restore 20% of missing HP when unleashing the slash. The healing effects of <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Return to Ashes</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice</color> have a shared cooldown and can trigger once every 20s.
If hit by an enemy during the skill, the slash is enhanced.
DMG taken is reduced by 40% while using this skill.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

Special.name: Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice
Special.desc:
Hold <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Enter a charging state, consuming up to 10% of Max HP and gaining 100 <color=#FFFFFF>Blazing Heart</color>. HP consumption will at most reduce Manato's HP to 30% of Max HP.
Release the button to activate <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Return to Ashes</color>. If struck during the skill, the slash heals 20% of missing HP. The healing effects of <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Return to Ashes</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice</color> have a shared cooldown and can trigger once every 20s.
If hit by an enemy during the skill or if charging reaches a certain duration, the slash is enhanced.
DMG taken is reduced by 40% while using this skill.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

Special.name: EX Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Fall
Special.desc:
While in the Molten Edge state and with sufficient Adrenaline, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Rp> to activate:
Jump up and unleash a falling slash on enemies in front, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Upon activating the skill, restore 33% of Max HP.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Special.name: EX Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Fall

Chain.desc:

Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Chain.name: Ultimate: Musou Aratama

Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Assist.name: Defensive Assist: Lone Shadow - Mountain Stand
Assist.desc:

Gain 75 <color=#FFFFFF>Blazing Heart</color> upon activating this skill.

Assist.name: Assist Follow-Up: Lone Shadow - Breaking Fang
Assist.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Unleash multiple slashes at enemies ahead, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Repeated presses allow up to 7 extra consecutive slashes.
While chaining slashes, if Manato's HP is above 30%, 2% of Max HP is consumed.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Assist.name: Defensive Assist: Lone Shadow - Mountain Stand
Assist Follow-Up: Lone Shadow - Breaking Fang

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Orbital Combo
Basic.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Perform up to five forward strikes, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
The fifth attack is a <color=#FFFFFF>Whim</color>, conjuring an Ethereal figure that inflicts <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color> on enemies in a circular area ahead.
When in combat and not in the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state, Lucia gains 40 <color=#FFFFFF>Dream Points</color> upon using this <color=#FFFFFF>Whim</color>.

Dodge.desc:

Dodge.desc:

Dodge.name: Dodge Counter: Stardust Echo
Dodge.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
This Dodge Counter is a <color=#FFFFFF>Whim</color>. When activated, summons an Ethereal figure that delivers a downward attack in a circular area ahead, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
If not in the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state, Lucia gains 20 <color=#FFFFFF>Dream Points</color> upon using this <color=#FFFFFF>Whim</color>. This effect can trigger once every 5s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Special.name: Special Attack: Symphony of the Reaper - Storm
Special.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
This Special Attack is a <color=#FFFFFF>Whim</color>. When activated, it recreates an Ethereal figure that slashes forward in a line, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
When in combat and not in the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state, Lucia gains 20 <color=#FFFFFF>Dream Points</color> upon using this <color=#FFFFFF>Whim</color>. This effect can trigger once every 5s.

Special.name: EX Special Attack: Symphony of the Reaper - Daybreak
Special.desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
This EX Special Attack is a <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color>. When activated, it summons an Ethereal figure that delivers a powerful forward slash in a line, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
When Lucia uses any <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color>, all squad members gain the <color=#FFFFFF>Darkbreaker</color> state. While in <color=#FFFFFF>Darkbreaker</color> state, Sheer Force increases by 12. Every 200 points of Lucia's initial Max HP grants an additional <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:5+AvatarSkillLevel(1)*0.2,1,1}</color> Sheer Force. The <color=#FFFFFF>Darkbreaker</color> state can increase Sheer Force by up to a maximum of <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:612+AvatarSkillLevel(1)*24,1,2}</color>, lasting 20s and repeated triggers reset the duration. When Lucia's initial Max HP reaches 24,000, the above bonus effect reaches its maximum value.
When any <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color> deals DMG, Lucia increases the final attack's DMG by an additional <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:0.34+AvatarSkillLevel(1)*0.03,100,2}%</color> of her Max HP.
If she activates this EX Special Attack while in the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state and under the effect of <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color> duration is extended by 16s.
After activating her EX Special Attack, Lucia can immediately follow up with the 5th hit of her <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>.
If not in the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state, Lucia gains 60 <color=#FFFFFF>Dream Points</color> upon using this <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Special.name: Special Attack: Symphony of the Reaper - Storm
EX Special Attack: Symphony of the Reaper - Daybreak

Chain.name: Chain Attack: Stage of Brilliance
Chain.desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
This Chain Attack is a <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color>. When activated, it summons an Ethereal figure that pulls in enemies in a circular area ahead and deals <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
If not in the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state, Lucia gains 40 <color=#FFFFFF>Dream Points</color> upon using this <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Chain.name: Ultimate: Charge, Great Armor!
Chain.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
This Ultimate is a <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color>. When activated, Lucia summons an Ethereal figure and rides it forward in a charge. Holding a directional button allows her to steer and extend the charge, up to 3s. During the charge, Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, DMG taken is reduced by 40%, and when Lucia takes fatal DMG, she remains in battle with HP not dropping below 1.
When the charge ends, Lucia unleashes a powerful strike in a large area around her, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>. A <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> is triggered when this skill hits an enemy, and after the skill is used, it leaves behind a <color=#FFFFFF>Starlight Convergence</color>. <color=#FFFFFF>Starlight Convergence</color> lasts 8s. While inside <color=#FFFFFF>Starlight Convergence</color>, the currently active character gains HP regeneration equal to <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:0.01+AvatarSkillLevel(3)*0.0005,100,2}%</color> of Lucia's Max HP per second. This effect ends 4s after leaving the <color=#FFFFFF>Starlight Convergence</color> or immediately when switching out.
After activation, if Lucia is in the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state and <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color> is active, <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color> duration is extended by 32s.
If not in the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state, Lucia gains 100 <color=#FFFFFF>Dream Points</color> upon using this <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color>. If she is in the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state when activating this <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color>, she will gain 100 <color=#FFFFFF>Dream Points</color> and re-enter <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state the next time she exits it. This effect cannot be stacked.
Character is invulnerable while performing the powerful strike.

Assist.name: Quick Assist: Crushing Mist
Assist.desc:

This Quick Assist is a <color=#FFFFFF>Whim</color>. When activated, it summons an Ethereal figure that delivers a downward attack in a circular area ahead, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
If not in the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state, Lucia gains 20 <color=#FFFFFF>Dream Points</color> upon using this <color=#FFFFFF>Whim</color>. This effect can trigger once every 5s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Assist Follow-Up: Harmony of Painted Dreams

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Chrysanthemum Wheel Dance
Basic.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Perform up to 4 attacks forward, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> for the first two hits and <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> for the third and fourth hits.
When attacked between the retreat of the 3rd hit to before the 4th hit, triggers an automatic dodge.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter
Basic.desc:
After the 4th hit of a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, hold or press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Summon the mech to perform a charged punch attack, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color> reaches 120, gain one chance to quickly activate <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter</color> by holding <IconMap:Icon_Normal>. This effect expires when <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color> is less than 120 or after using the method above to activate <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter</color> once.
Does not accumulate <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color> on hit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Downfall
Basic.desc:
Seed has <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color>, which she can accumulate by hitting enemies with her skills.
<color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color> has a maximum value of 150, and an initial value of 60. Upon reaching 120 <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color> and triggering <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Clockwork Garden - Bloom!</color>, press or hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to consume 60 <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color> and unleash <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Downfall First Form</color>, then automatically consume 60 <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color> to follow up with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Downfall Second Form</color>.
Pilots the mech to fire sweeping shots and perform a jumping smash, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Does not accumulate <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color> on hit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Downfall First Form
Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Downfall Second Form

Unleash a barrage of lasers at enemies in front, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.

Special.name: Special Attack: Withered in Frost
Special.desc:

Throw a steel wheel that traces a curved path, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.

Special.name: EX Special Attack: Raining Iron Petals
Special.desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Enter flight mode, where Seed can move in four directions, and unleash a continuous barrage of missiles, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Hold <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to extend the barrage duration while continuously consuming Energy.
During flight, release <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Raining Iron Petals - Away</color>.
Upon consuming 60 Energy points in one flight, automatically trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Special.name: EX Special Attack: Raining Iron Petals - Away
Special.desc:
During <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Raining Iron Petals</color>, release <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Unleash rapid cannon fire, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Does not accumulate <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color> on hit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Special.name: EX Special Attack: Raining Iron Petals
EX Special Attack: Raining Iron Petals - Away

Chain.name: Chain Attack: Tempest of Frosty Petals
Chain.desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Summons her mech for protection, then launches cannon shots and a barrage of missiles, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Chain.name: Ultimate: Clockwork Garden - Bloom!
Chain.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Seed will pilot the mech personally, raining down missiles and a meteor shower of rockets, then performing a jumping smash, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
After using this skill, accumulate 60 <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color>.
Does not accumulate <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color> on hit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Chain.name: Chain Attack: Tempest of Frosty Petals

Assist.desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.

Assist.name: Assist Follow-Up: Crimson Core Burst
Assist.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Unleash continuous floating turret attacks at enemies ahead, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Towering Peaks
Basic.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Launches up to four attacks in front, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Interrupt Level is increased during this skill.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Majestic Summit
Basic.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Launches up to four attacks in front, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Anti-Interrupt Level is increased during this skill.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Immolate
Basic.desc:
While not in the <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state and with at least 120 <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Deals <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> to nearby enemies, then enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Inflame
Basic.desc:
While not in combat and with more than 50% HP and less than 120 <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Banyue consumes HP to recover <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color>. Upon reaching 120 <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color>, Banyue immediately enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state.
Upon entering the battlefield, gain one chance to use this skill. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once per 180s.
HP consumption will at most reduce Banyue's HP to 50% of Max HP.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Toppling Mountain
Basic.desc:
When Banyue is in the <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to consume 120 <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color> and activate:
Banyue hurls a massive mountain at the enemy, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
After using this move, Banyue exits the <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Crushing Peaks
Basic.desc:
While Banyue is in the <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state and after performing two different <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attacks</color> through Basic Attack branches or quick input commands, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Banyue launches his beads forward to imprison enemies, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Banyue automatically follows up with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Toppling Mountain</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Dodge.name: Dodge: Immovable Mountain
Dodge.desc:
While attacking, press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> without moving the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} to activate:
Banyue enters a defensive stance. If attacked during this time, he parries the enemy's attack and accumulates Daze.
If attacked at the exact moment the skill is activated, a Perfect Block occurs.
Character is invulnerable during a successful parry.

Dodge.name: Dodge: Overcome Peaks
Dodge.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Dodge.name: Dodge: Battle Cry
Dodge.desc:
Rotate the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} in a half-circle and press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
Dodges backward and taunts enemies.
After any <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, follow up with <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge: Battle Cry</color> and quickly execute the required inputs during <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge: Battle Cry</color> to then follow up with the corresponding <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Dodge.name: Dash Attack: Scattering Sands
Dodge.desc:
During a dodge, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal>, or during <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge: Battle Cry</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Launches beads forward, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
After using this skill, can be followed up with the 2nd hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Towering Peaks</color> or the 2nd hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Majestic Summit</color>.

Dodge.name: Dodge Counter: Stoneburst
Dodge.desc:
After a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> is triggered through <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge: Overcome Peaks</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal>, or after a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> is triggered though <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge: Battle Cry</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Launches a forward attack that deals <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
After using this skill, can be chained into the 3rd hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Towering Peaks</color> or the 3rd hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Majestic Summit</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Special.name: EX Special Attack: Earth Shaker
Special.desc:
With enough Adrenaline, can be activated in one of three ways:
After the 3rd or 4th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Towering Peaks</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Rp> to activate:
After an <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Rp> to activate:
During an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Immolate</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, quickly input <IconMap:Icon_Normal> <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Rp> <IconMap:Icon_Normal> in sequence to activate:
Banyue slams the ground repeatedly, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Special.name: EX Special Attack: Mountain Tremor
Special.desc:
With enough Adrenaline, can be activated in one of two ways:
After the 1st or 2nd hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Majestic Summit</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
During an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Immolate</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, quickly input <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Rp> <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Rp> <IconMap:Icon_Normal> in sequence to activate:
Banyue throws a mountain, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Special.name: EX Special Attack: One's Path
Special.desc:
With enough Adrenaline, can be activated in one of three ways:

If Nangong Yu activates <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise</color> again, the current <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise</color> will first deactivate.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Assist.name: Quick Assist: Emergency Save
Assist.desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Launches a series of attacks on the target, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Assist.name: Defensive Assist: Perfected Choreography
Assist.desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Points</color> when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Assist.name: Assist Follow-Up: Improvised Performance
Assist.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Launches a series of attacks on the target, dealing massive <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Tongue Flick
Basic.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Launch up to four attacks forward, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
When the 4th hit lands, gain 2 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Venom</color>. Hitting a Stunned enemy grants an additional 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Venom</color>.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Serpent's Kiss
Basic.desc:
With <color=#FFFFFF>Serpentine Shadow</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to launch:
Cissia leaps into the air and locks onto a target, then slams down, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> to enemies in the area.
While locking on, continue to hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> and drag the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} to extend the lock-on duration and freely control the landing position.
For every 6 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Venom</color> gained, gain 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Serpentine Shadow</color>, stacking up to 3 times.
Upon entering the battlefield, gain 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Serpentine Shadow</color>.
Using this skill consumes 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Serpentine Shadow</color>.
Upon hitting an enemy, all <color=#FFFFFF>Venom</color> is consumed to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Corrode Bone</color>.
Upon activating this skill, a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> is triggered.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Basic.name: Corrode Bone
Basic.desc:
Deal <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> to nearby enemies.
Each trigger increases CRIT Rate by 6% for 15s, stacking up to 3 times. Repeated triggers refresh the duration.

Dodge.name: Dodge: Slither
Dodge.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Dodge.name: Dash Attack: Bite Mark
Dodge.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Dash forward with a swift slash, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.

Dodge.name: Dodge Counter: Bite Back
Dodge.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Leap forward and perform a sweeping attack upon landing, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Special.name: Special Attack: Bared Fangs
Special.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Launches a long-range snake bite forward, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

Special.name: EX Special Attack: Venomous Bite
Special.desc:
With enough energy, press or hold <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Unleash multiple long-range snake bites forward, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Grants 5 Energy when the move is used.
When activating by holding, consumes additional Energy. For every 20 additional Energy consumed, unleash 1 extra strike that deals <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>, up to a maximum of 60 additional Energy.
After activation, gain 3 <color=#FFFFFF>Venom</color>. For every additional 20 Energy consumed while holding, gain 1 more <color=#FFFFFF>Venom</color>.
After using this skill, it can be immediately followed up with the 4th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Tongue Flick</color>.
A <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Chain.name: Chain Attack: Gang Operation
Chain.desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Launch multiple attacks ahead, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
After using this skill, gain 3 <color=#FFFFFF>Venom</color>.
A <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Chain.name: Ultimate: Ophidiophobia
Chain.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Deliver a thunderbolt attack in front, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
After using this skill, obtain 3 <color=#FFFFFF>Venom</color>.
After using this skill, activate <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Cold-Blooded</color>, lasting 30s. All squad members' CRIT DMG increases by 5% for the duration.
Re-activating <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Cold-Blooded</color> a second time will first deactivate the active <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Cold-Blooded</color>.
A <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Assist.name: Quick Assist: Alarm System
Assist.desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Leaps forward and performs a sweeping attack upon landing, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
During this skill, you can quickly chain into <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Bared Fangs</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Venomous Bite</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Serpent's Kiss</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Assist.name: Defensive Assist: Extra Prison Rations
Assist.desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Assist.name: Assist Follow-Up: Partners in Crime
Assist.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Unleash a series of attacks, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Knight's Technique
Basic.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Performs up to four attacks forward, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
During the 4th hit, press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to use <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Drive Suppression</color>, reducing HP consumption by 50%.
Restores a small amount of HP on hit.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Full-Throttle Starlight
Basic.desc:
With enough <color=#FFFFFF>Determination</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Charges forward on the motorcycle, then fires a laser beam, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Dodge.name: Dodge: Close Call!
Dodge.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Dodge.name: Dodge: Through the Galaxy
Dodge.desc:
During <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Drive Suppression</color>, drag the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} or hold <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
Drifts with the motorcycle, enabling <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodges</color> for a brief duration.
If a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> is successfully triggered, it immediately chains into <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter: Afterfire Spin</color>.
During this skill, continue dragging the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} or holding <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to continue drifting.
During this skill, the duration of <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Drive Suppression</color> will continue, and upon reaching the maximum duration, it automatically chains into <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie</color>.
If the skill ends early, it automatically chains into <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Run Wild</color>.
Character is briefly invulnerable and Anti-Interrupt Level increases during this skill.

Dodge.name: Dash Attack: Starlight Retribution
Dodge.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Performs a quick forward slash, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.

Dodge.name: Dodge Counter: Duel King
Dodge.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Fires a blast from his arm cannon, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
If this skill is triggered via a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>, hitting an enemy restores 10% of Max HP, and it can be chained into the 4th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Knight's Technique</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Dodge.name: Dodge Counter: Afterfire Spin
Dodge.desc:
During <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge: Through the Galaxy</color>, trigger a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Spins with the bike to deal <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> to surrounding enemies.
After using this skill, it automatically chains into <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Special.name: Special Attack: Drive Suppression
Special.desc:
When HP is above 25%, press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Consumes HP equal to 16% of Max HP to summon a motorcycle and swiftly crash into enemies, continuously dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
If attacked by an enemy as the active character shortly upon activating this skill, triggers a block, negating the attack and restoring 5 <color=#FFFFFF>Determination</color>.
After triggering a block, immediately chains into <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie</color>.
After the skill continues for a while, it automatically chains into <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie</color>.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

Special.name: Special Attack: Run Wild
Special.desc:
Triggers automatically when <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge: Through the Galaxy</color> is interrupted:
Kicks his motorcycle at enemies, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
After using this skill, it can be chained into <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter: Duel King</color>.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

Special.name: EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie
Special.desc:
Triggers automatically when <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Drive Suppression</color> reaches its maximum duration or a block is triggered:
Lifts the motorcycle to attack enemies, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
On hit, restores an additional 8 <color=#FFFFFF>Determination</color>.
After using this skill, with enough Adrenaline, press or hold <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Rp> to chain into <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Rocking Footwork</color>.
After the skill animation ends, automatically chains into <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Run Wild</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Special.name: EX Special Attack: High-Traction Wheels
Special.desc:
With enough Adrenaline, hold <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Rp> to activate:
Slams down with the motorcycle, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Restores 30% of Max HP upon activating this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Special.name: EX Special Attack: Rocking Footwork
Special.desc:
After activating <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie</color> and with enough Adrenaline, press or hold <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Rp> to activate:
Uses the motorcycle and hand cannon for a combined attack, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Upon activating this skill, restore 15% of Max HP.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Chain.name: Chain Attack: Knight's Swagger
Chain.desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Launches a series of attacks forward, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Upon activating this skill, gains 15 <color=#FFFFFF>Determination</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Chain.name: Ultimate: Starlight Knight Flying Kick
Chain.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Leaps into the air and delivers a flying kick at the target, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Assist.name: Quick Assist: Starlight - Power of Bonds
Assist.desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Fires a blast from his arm cannon ahead, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>. When HP is above 25%, this skill is replaced with <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Drive Suppression</color>. This effect can trigger once every 5s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Assist.name: Defensive Assist: Hero's Entrance
Assist.desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Assist.name: Assist Follow-Up: Villain's Exit
Assist.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Kicks the motorcycle at the target, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Assist.name: Quick Assist: Starlight - Power of Bonds

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Sweeping Edge
Basic.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Performs up to five attacks against enemies ahead, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
After landing the fifth hit's downward attack, and with sufficient <color=#FFFFFF>Trial by Cold</color>, keep holding <IconMap:Icon_Special> or <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to chain into <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Execution - Merciless Judgment</color>.
Enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Bound Absolution</color> state after throwing the cape during the fourth hit.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Whirling Blade
Basic.desc:
Hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Promeia leaps into the air and attacks, throwing her cape beside the enemy and entering the <color=#FFFFFF>Bound Absolution</color> state, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Hitting enemies does not accumulate <color=#FFFFFF>Corrosive Chill</color>.

Basic.name: Bound Absolution
Basic.desc:
When using certain skills, Promeia throws her cape to continuously slice enemies, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>. Does not accumulate <color=#FFFFFF>Corrosive Chill</color> upon hit.
While the cape remains out, Promeia can walk slowly.
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> or <IconMap:Icon_Special> during this period to immediately follow up with the 5th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sweeping Edge</color>.
If attacked during this period, Promeia triggers a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> automatically. The dodge can trigger once every 20s.

Dodge.name: Dodge: Veiled Step
Dodge.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Dodge.name: Dash Attack: Grim Reap
Dodge.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Delivers a quick attack forward, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.

Dodge.name: Dodge Counter: Soaring Bat
Dodge.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Unleashes consecutive attacks against the target, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
After using this skill, it can be immediately followed up with the 5th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sweeping Edge</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Special.name: Special Attack: Execution - Cold Flash
Special.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Launches a flying blade attack, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.

Special.name: EX Special Attack: Execution - Glacial Death
Special.desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Performs a flying blade attack, throwing her cape beside the enemy and entering the <color=#FFFFFF>Bound Absolution</color> state, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
If attacked by an enemy shortly after using the move, automatically chains into <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Execution - Shrouded in Shadow</color>.
Upon use, Promeia gains the <color=#FFFFFF>Absolute Order</color> effect.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Special.name: EX Special Attack: Execution - Shrouded in Shadow
Special.desc:
Triggers automatically when hit shortly upon activating <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Execution - Glacial Death</color>:
Enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Vital View</color> state briefly and swiftly circles behind the enemy.
After triggering a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>, and with enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to consume 40 Energy and activate <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Execution - Shrouded in Shadow</color>, gaining the <color=#FFFFFF>Absolute Order</color> effect.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Special.name: Special Attack: Execution - Descending Frost
Special.desc:
While under the <color=#FFFFFF>Absolute Order</color> effect, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> or <IconMap:Icon_Special> while in the <color=#FFFFFF>Bound Absolution</color> state to activate:
Leaps toward the enemy, retrieving the cape while performing a descending attack that deals <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
After landing, if Promeia possesses <color=#FFFFFF>Trial by Cold</color>, keep holding <IconMap:Icon_Normal> or <IconMap:Icon_Special> to chain into <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Execution - Merciless Judgment</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Special.name: Special Attack: Execution - Layered Frost
Special.desc:
After triggering <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Execution - Shrouded in Shadow</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> or <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Quickly launches a flurry of attacks, then leaps toward the enemy, retrieving the cape while performing a more powerful downward attack that deals <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
After landing, if Promeia possesses <color=#FFFFFF>Trial by Cold</color>, keep holding <IconMap:Icon_Normal> or <IconMap:Icon_Special> to chain into <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Execution - Merciless Judgment</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Special.name: EX Special Attack: Execution - Merciless Judgment
Special.desc:
With enough <color=#FFFFFF>Trial by Cold</color> and after performing the final hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sweeping Edge</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Execution - Descending Frost</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Execution - Layered Frost</color>, keep holding <IconMap:Icon_Normal> or <IconMap:Icon_Special> after landing to activate:
Quickly leaps back while unleashing a more powerful finishing move, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Hitting enemies does not accumulate <color=#FFFFFF>Corrosive Chill</color>.
After using this skill, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> or <IconMap:Icon_Special>, or press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to immediately follow up with the 5th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sweeping Edge</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Special.name: EX Special Attack: Execution - Glacial Death
EX Special Attack: Execution - Merciless Judgment

Chain.name: Chain Attack: Hanging Judgment
Chain.desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Throws flying blades and hangs upside down above the enemy, unleashing a flurry of attacks and ending with a finishing move, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
When the heavy attack hits an enemy afflicted with <color=#98EFF0>Ice Anomaly</color>, <color=#FE437E>Ether Anomaly</color>, <color=#2EB6FF>Electric Anomaly</color>, <color=#FF5521>Fire Anomaly</color>, <color=#F0D12B>Physical Anomaly</color>, or <color=#A6C5FD>Wind Anomaly</color>, it triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> once, dealing 100% Attribute Anomaly DMG of the corresponding attribute.
After using this skill, it can be immediately followed up with the 5th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sweeping Edge</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Chain.name: Ultimate: Glaciating Impalement
Chain.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Launches a series of forward attacks, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
When the heavy attack hits an enemy afflicted with <color=#98EFF0>Ice Anomaly</color>, <color=#FE437E>Ether Anomaly</color>, <color=#2EB6FF>Electric Anomaly</color>, <color=#FF5521>Fire Anomaly</color>, <color=#F0D12B>Physical Anomaly</color>, or <color=#A6C5FD>Wind Anomaly</color>, it triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> once, dealing 250% Attribute Anomaly DMG of the corresponding attribute.
After using this skill, it can be immediately followed up with the 5th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sweeping Edge</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Assist.name: Quick Assist: Ambushing Strike
Assist.desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Unleashes consecutive attacks against the target, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Assist.name: Defensive Assist: Injunction
Assist.desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Assist.name: Assist Follow-Up: Intercepting Strike
Assist.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Unleashes consecutive attacks against the target, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
After using this skill, it can be immediately followed up with the 5th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sweeping Edge</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Emberglow
Basic.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Performs up to three attacks forward, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Celestial Light
Basic.desc:
With 30 or more <Term:1000018>Solar Prominence</Term>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Unleashes up to four attacks forward, dealing massive <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
If another character is switched in during the 3rd hit, Pyrois automatically performs the 4th hit off-field.
Each hit consumes a certain amount of Solar Prominence.
Character is invulnerable during the 3rd and 4th hits.

Dodge.name: Dodge: Twilight
Dodge.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Dodge.name: Dash Attack: Sunrise
Dodge.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Delivers a quick slash forward, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.

Dodge.name: Dodge Counter: First Light
Dodge.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Performs a forward spinning slash, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
After using the skill and with 30 or more <Term:1000018>Solar Prominence</Term>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Celestial Light.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Special.name: Special Attack: Fading Rays
Special.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Performs a rush attack, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.

Special.name: EX Special Attack: Sun's Halo
Special.desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Quickly charges forward and performs a series of consecutive attacks, dealing massive <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
If hit by an enemy attack during the charge, triggers a Perfect Block effect, nullifying the damage and increasing the move's Interrupt Level to that of a Heavy Defensive Assist.
After using the skill and with 30 or more <Term:1000018>Solar Prominence</Term>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Celestial Light.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Special.name: Special Attack: Assault Directive
Special.desc: When an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Sun's Halo</color> is used, Phaethon performs an assist attack, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>. This effect can trigger once every 2.5s, and is guaranteed to trigger when using an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>.

Chain.name: Chain Attack: Ceremonial March
Chain.desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Performs a coordinated attack with Phaethon, dealing massive <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
After using the skill and with 30 or more <Term:1000018>Solar Prominence</Term>, press or hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Celestial Light.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Chain.name: Ultimate: Total Annihilation
Chain.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at or above <color=#FFFFFF>Blasting</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> and select the upper branch to activate:
After charging, performs a downward slash, dealing massive <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
After using the skill and with 30 or more <Term:1000018>Solar Prominence</Term>, press or hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Celestial Light.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Chain.name: Ultimate: Triumphant Return
Chain.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at or above <color=#FFFFFF>Blasting</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> and select the lower branch to activate:
Releases an energy burst in the surrounding area, dealing massive <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
After using the skill and with 30 or more <Term:1000018>Solar Prominence</Term>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Celestial Light.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Chain.name: Ultimate: Unbound Swordstorm
Chain.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at or above <color=#FFFFFF>Blasting</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> and select the left branch to activate:
Unleashes consecutive attacks forward, dealing massive <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
After using the skill and with 30 or more <Term:1000018>Solar Prominence</Term>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Celestial Light.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Chain.name: Ultimate: Eternal Imprisonment
Chain.desc:

After Norma retrieves the <color=#FFFFFF>Top Hat Companion</color>, she immediately gains the stored <color=#FFFFFF>Preheated Chamber</color>.
When holding <IconMap:Icon_Normal>, the <color=#FFFFFF>Top Hat Companion</color> will accelerate toward Norma.
If retrieving the <color=#FFFFFF>Top Hat Companion</color> would raise <color=#FFFFFF>Preheated Chamber</color> to 80% or higher, the <color=#FFFFFF>Top Hat Companion</color> will automatically accelerate toward Norma.
When Norma switches from on field to off field while in combat, if <color=#FFFFFF>Preheated Chamber</color> is not full, <color=#FFFFFF>Top Hat Companion</color> automatically enters the battlefield.

While <color=#FFFFFF>En-Nah Barrage</color> is active, Norma deploys two <color=#FFFFFF>En-Nah Turrets</color> to join the battle.
Continuing to hold extends the firing time by up to 2s, continuously consuming energy. For each 1 point of energy consumed while holding, Norma gains an additional 0.4% <color=#FFFFFF>Preheated Chamber</color>, and this round of <color=#FFFFFF>En-Nah Barrage</color> lasts 0.8s longer, up to a maximum additional duration of {CAL:2*20*0.8,1,2}s.

Special.name: Special Attack: Ode to Dawn - Radiant Turn
Special.desc:
When Remielle is in combat and her <color=#FFFFFF>Floating Radiance</color> reaches its maximum of 120, hold <IconMap:Icon_Special> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> to enter <color=#FFFFFF>Stance Shift</color>. Switching characters while in <color=#FFFFFF>Stance Shift</color> causes Remielle to enter the <color=#FFFFFF>Phase Flow</color> state:
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Phase Flow</color> state, Remielle acts autonomously to assist in combat. In this state, <color=#FFFFFF>Floating Radiance</color> is consumed over time, and some of her attacks apply <color=#FFA9DD>Lumiflux Buildup</color> to the target. When <color=#FFFFFF>Floating Radiance</color> is fully depleted or upon leaving combat, Remielle exits the <color=#FFFFFF>Phase Flow</color> state. Before exiting the <color=#FFFFFF>Phase Flow</color> state, Remielle cannot be actively switched in except via a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>.
If Remielle triggers 3 <Term:1000031></Term> reactions in one <color=#FFFFFF>Phase Flow</color> state, or has at least 1 stored <Term:1000033></Term> when <color=#FFFFFF>Floating Radiance</color> is fully depleted, <color=#FFFFFF>Assist: Flower & Feather Dance</color> becomes available, and her normal switch-in is unlocked. <color=#FFFFFF>Assist: Flower & Feather Dance</color> is automatically used on Remielle's next normal switch-in.
Upon entering the <color=#FFFFFF>Phase Flow</color> state, Remielle increases all squad members's DMG by <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:0+AvatarSkillLevel(1)*1.5,1,2}%</color> for 60s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
When Remielle's <color=#FFFFFF>Floating Radiance</color> has reached its maximum of 120 and her <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> hits a Stunned enemy, she can also enter the <color=#FFFFFF>Phase Flow</color> state by switching characters during the <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>.
If no character is switched in after entering <color=#FFFFFF>Stance Shift</color>, Remielle uses a downward attack to return to the ground instead.

Remielle also enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Luminous Reflection</color> state, and the next <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Rainbow's End</color> is upgraded to <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Fleeting Grace</color>.
When this skill hits a Stunned enemy, their Stun duration is extended by 3s. Each enemy can be affected by this effect only once per Stun window. This Stun duration increase cannot stack with other effects of the same type.
If this skill lands a hit, the <Term:1000034></Term> effect can be triggered after the skill ends with a multiplier of <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:200+AvatarSkillLevel(6)*10,1,2}%</color>.

Basic.name: Basic Attack: Converging Spear

<color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Converging Spear</color> has three stages. Each use advances it to the next stage. After performing the third stage of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Converging Spear</color>, it resets to the first stage.
If Sigrid is attacked while charging the 1st or 2nd stage of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Converging Spear</color>, she blocks with her shield. On a successful block, the attack's DMG is negated, the next <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Converging Spear</color> deals 100% more Daze, the <Term:1000030></Term> state is refreshed, and she gains one use of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Converging Spear</color>. Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a successful block to perform the corresponding stage of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Converging Spear</color>.
<color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Converging Spear</color> performed after <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Frost-Tipped Spear</color> retains the current stage of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Frost-Tipped Spear</color>.
DMG taken is reduced by 60% during this skill.
